_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-29 11:39:05Z)**_

The aquarium should hold your **tech stack**. Right now everything on the desk does a job: the folder holds your experience, the books hold your projects, the card holds your contact details and the Instax opens the photobooth. Your skills are the one thing that only exists as a static section ([TechStack.tsx](src/components/sections/TechStack.tsx)). The tank can hold them, and it can also link back to the books.

## Main idea: each fish is a skill

- **One fish per technology** from `techStack` in [content.ts](src/lib/content.ts): React, Spring Boot, MySQL and the rest. Each species or color stands for one technology.
- **Size or speed shows experience.** Bigger or more confident fish are the tools you use most. The sizes can come from your data: count how many entries in `projects[].tools` include each skill. Spring Boot is in 5 projects, so it's a big fish. OAuth is in 1, so it's a small one.
- **Clicking a fish opens a small label card** in the same style as your desk item notes. It shows the skill name, years used and "Used in: ABC Jobs, Meals On Wheels…".
- **The link to the books:** when someone picks a fish, the project books that use that skill light up or tilt out on the shelf. In reverse, opening a book makes its fish gather at the front of the glass. Visitors get a way to browse your work by skill, and you don't need any new content to do it.

One thing to fix first: the tool names don't always match. `projects` says "React JS" in some places and `techStack` says "React". Normalizing them to shared IDs is about a 10-minute job and makes the mapping reliable.

## Optional extras

1. **Live GitHub feeding.** Pull your recent public activity from the GitHub API on the server and refresh it every hour or so (incremental static regeneration (ISR) or a route handler). A "Feed" button drops pellets, and each pellet is a real recent commit, shown as "fixed cart totals · 2 days ago". It quietly tells visitors that you're still shipping. Small cost: one API call, cached.
2. **The tank shows how recently you've been active.** It's clearer and more lively when you've pushed code lately. It's subtle and just for fun, so keep it secondary.
3. **Visitor guestbook fish.** A visitor leaves their name and a short note, and a small fish with their name joins the tank. It's memorable, but it needs storage (Supabase, Vercel KV) and moderation, so I'd leave it for later.

## Practical notes

- **Performance:** you recently worked on making the desk lighter to load. Use simple low-poly fish with instanced meshes and basic flocking for the swimming. Only run that while the tank is on screen, and calm it down for visitors who have reduced motion turned on.
- **Phones:** tapping a fish should do the same thing as clicking it. Tiny fish are hard to tap, so give each one a larger tap area than it looks.
- **Placement:** a shelf or the corner of the desk next to the books keeps the fish-to-book link visible in one view.

I'd build the skill fish with the book link first and add GitHub feeding second. Want me to start? I'd begin by checking how the books are built, so the highlight works with them.

13	function useOak() {
14	  const maps = useTexture({
15	    map: "/textures/oak_veneer_01/diffuse.jpg",
16	    roughnessMap: "/textures/oak_veneer_01/rough.jpg",
17	    normalMap: "/textures/oak_veneer_01/nor_gl.jpg",
18	  });
19	  return useMemo(() => {
20	    const make = (repeatX: number, repeatY: number, rotate = false) => {
21	      const out: Record<string, THREE.Texture> = {};
22	      for (const [k, t] of Object.entries(maps)) {
23	        const c = t.clone();
24	        c.wrapS = c.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
25	        c.repeat.set(repeatX, repeatY);
26	        if (rotate) c.rotation = Math.PI / 2;
27	        if (k === "map") c.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
28	        c.anisotropy = 8;
29	        c.needsUpdate = true;
30	        out[k] = c;
31	      }
32	      return out as typeof maps;
33	    };
34	    return { top: make(2.4, 0.8), front: make(2.4, 0.4) };
35	  }, [maps]);
36	}

189	/* Mutable animation state for the books, kept out of React. */
190	class ShelfAnim {
191	  private p: number[];
192	  private hover: number[];
193	  private groups: (THREE.Group | null)[] = [];
194	  private dim: THREE.Mesh | null = null;
195	  private tmp = {
196	    pos: new THREE.Vector3(),
197	    pulled: new THREE.Vector3(),
198	    present: new THREE.Vector3(),
199	    fwd: new THREE.Vector3(),
200	    right: new THREE.Vector3(),
201	    q: new THREE.Quaternion(),
202	  };
203	  private torch: THREE.SpotLight | null = null;
204	  private torchLevel = 0;
205	  private torchOnAt = -1;
206	  private clock = 0;
207	  private aim = new THREE.Vector3();
208	  private ray = new THREE.Raycaster();
209	  private plane = new THREE.Plane();
210	  hovered = -1;
211	  active: number | null = null;
212	  readonly shelfQ = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromAxisAngle(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), Math.PI / 2);
213	  readonly slots: THREE.Vector3[];
214	
215	  constructor(count: number) {
216	    this.p = Array.from({ length: count }, () => 0);
217	    this.hover = Array.from({ length: count }, () => 0);
218	    let x = -2.25;
219	    this.slots = THICK.slice(0, count).map((t, i) => {
220	      const cx = x + t / 2;
221	      x += t + 0.04;
222	      return new THREE.Vector3(SHELF.x + cx, 0.2 + HEIGHT[i] / 2, SHELF.z + 1.0);
223	    });
224	  }
225	
226	  attach(i: number, g: THREE.Group | null) {
227	    this.groups[i] = g;
228	  }
229	
230	  /*
231	   * Flashlight held just off the camera's shoulder. It clicks on with a short
232	   * stutter once the book is open, then tracks the cursor across the pages.
233	   */
234	  private stepTorch(camera: THREE.PerspectiveCamera, fwd: THREE.Vector3, dist: number, dt: number, reduced: boolean, on: boolean, pointer: THREE.Vector2) {
235	    const torch = this.torch;
236	    if (!torch) return;
237	
238	    if (on && this.torchOnAt < 0) this.torchOnAt = this.clock;
239	    if (!on) this.torchOnAt = -1;
240	    let goal = 0;
241	    if (on) {
242	      const step = Math.floor((this.clock - this.torchOnAt) / 0.06);
243	      goal = reduced ? 1 : (TORCH_FLICKER[step] ?? 1);
244	    }
245	    this.torchLevel = reduced || goal > this.torchLevel ? goal : THREE.MathUtils.damp(this.torchLevel, goal, 8, dt);
246	    /* intensity only; toggling visibility would recompile every lit material */
247	    torch.intensity = 1.7 * dist * this.torchLevel;
248	
249	    /* hand position: a little right of and below the eye */
250	    const up = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0).applyQuaternion(camera.quaternion);
251	    const right = new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0).applyQuaternion(camera.quaternion);
252	    torch.position.copy(camera.position).addScaledVector(right, 1.6).addScaledVector(up, -1.1);
253	
254	    /* aim where the cursor meets the page plane */
255	    const center = camera.position.clone().addScaledVector(fwd, dist);
256	    this.plane.setFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint(fwd.clone().negate(), center);
257	    this.ray.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
258	    const hit = this.ray.ray.intersectPlane(this.plane, new THREE.Vector3()) ?? center;
259	    /* while off, park on the middle of the spread so the beam sweeps out to the cursor */
260	    if (this.torchLevel === 0) this.aim.copy(center);
261	    if (reduced) this.aim.copy(hit);
262	    this.aim.x = THREE.MathUtils.damp(this.aim.x, hit.x, 9, dt);
263	    this.aim.y = THREE.MathUtils.damp(this.aim.y, hit.y, 9, dt);
264	    this.aim.z = THREE.MathUtils.damp(this.aim.z, hit.z, 9, dt);
265	    torch.target.position.copy(this.aim);
266	    torch.target.updateMatrixWorld();
267	  }
268	
269	  attachTorch(l: THREE.SpotLight | null) {
270	    this.torch = l;
271	  }
272	
273	  attachDim(m: THREE.Mesh | null) {
274	    this.dim = m;
275	  }
276	
277	  setHovered(i: number) {
278	    this.hovered = i;
279	  }
280	
281	  setActive(i: number | null) {
282	    this.active = i;
283	  }
284	
285	  step(camera: THREE.PerspectiveCamera, aspect: number, delta: number, reduced: boolean, night: boolean, pointer: THREE.Vector2, link: SceneLink) {
286	    const { tmp } = this;
287	    const dt = Math.min(delta, 1 / 30);
288	    this.clock += dt;
289	    let openAmount = 0;
290	    const tanHalf = Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(camera.fov / 2));
291	    const widthFrac = aspect < 1 ? 0.92 : 0.5;
292	    const openW = BOOK_W * 2.1;
293	    const dist = Math.max(openW / (widthFrac * 2 * tanHalf * aspect), 3.4 / (0.7 * 2 * tanHalf));
294	    camera.getWorldDirection(tmp.fwd);
295	    tmp.right.set(1, 0, 0).applyQuaternion(camera.quaternion);
296	
297	    let dimAmount = 0;
298	    for (let i = 0; i < this.p.length; i++) {
299	      /* only one book out at a time: the old one goes home before the next leaves */
300	      const othersOut = this.p.some((v, k) => k !== i && v > 0.001);
301	      const goal = this.active === i && !(othersOut && this.p[i] === 0) ? 1 : 0;
302	      const step = reduced ? 1 : dt / OPEN_SECONDS;
303	      this.p[i] = goal > this.p[i] ? Math.min(goal, this.p[i] + step) : Math.max(goal, this.p[i] - step * 1.3);
304	      this.hover[i] = THREE.MathUtils.damp(this.hover[i], this.hovered === i && this.p[i] === 0 ? 1 : 0, 12, dt);
305	
306	      const p = this.p[i];
307	      const s1 = phase(p, 0, 0.22);
308	      const s2 = phase(p, 0.22, 0.7);
309	      const s3 = phase(p, 0.7, 1);
310	      dimAmount = Math.max(dimAmount, s2);
311	      openAmount = Math.max(openAmount, s3);
312	
313	      const g = this.groups[i];
314	      if (!g) continue;
315	      tmp.pulled.copy(this.slots[i]).add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.25, 1.9));
316	      tmp.pos.copy(this.slots[i]).lerp(tmp.pulled, s1);
317	      tmp.pos.z += this.hover[i] * 0.35;
318	      tmp.present
319	        .copy(camera.position)
320	        .addScaledVector(tmp.fwd, dist)
321	        .addScaledVector(tmp.right, -(BOOK_W / 2) * (1 - s3));
322	      tmp.pos.lerp(tmp.present, s2);
323	      g.position.copy(tmp.pos);
324	      tmp.q.copy(this.shelfQ).slerp(camera.quaternion, s2);
325	      g.quaternion.copy(tmp.q);
326	      const cover = g.getObjectByName(`cover-${i}`);
327	      if (cover) cover.rotation.y = -Math.PI * 0.985 * s3;
328	    }
329	
330	    link.setBook(camera.position.clone().addScaledVector(tmp.fwd, dist), tmp.fwd.clone().negate(), openAmount);
331	    /* a hand-held flashlight takes over from the built-in reading torch */
332	    this.stepTorch(camera, tmp.fwd, dist, dt, reduced, night && !link.flashHeld && openAmount > 0.6 && this.active !== null, pointer);
333	
334	    if (this.dim) {
335	      const mat = this.dim.material as THREE.MeshBasicMaterial;
336	      mat.opacity = dimAmount * 0.55;
337	      const live = dimAmount > 0.01;
338	      this.dim.visible = live;
339	      this.dim.position.copy(camera.position).addScaledVector(tmp.fwd, live ? dist + 1.2 : -50);
340	      this.dim.quaternion.copy(camera.quaternion);
341	    }
342	  }
343	}

345	export function ProjectShelf({ projects, open, reduced, night, link, onOpen, onHover, onLoaded }: ShelfProps) {

347	  const size = useThree((s) => s.size);
348	  const [tex, setTex] = useState<BookTextures | null>(null);
349	  const [anim] = useState(() => new ShelfAnim(projects.length));
350	
351	  useEffect(() => {

353	    let built: BookTextures | null = null;

356	      if (!alive) return;
357	      setTex(t);
358	      onLoaded?.();
359	    });

377	      {/* floating tag so the shelf reads as the way into the work */}

383	          </button>
384	        </Html>
385	      )}

387	      {/* the shelf itself */}
388	      <group position={[SHELF.x, 0, SHELF.z]}>
389	        <mesh position={[0, 0.1, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow>
390	          <boxGeometry args={[4.9, 0.2, 2.2]} />
391	          <meshStandardMaterial color="#6b4428" roughness={0.6} />
392	        </mesh>
393	        {[-2.45, 2.45].map((x) => (
394	          <mesh key={x} position={[x, 1.9, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow>
395	            <boxGeometry args={[0.2, 3.8, 2.2]} />
396	            <meshStandardMaterial color="#6b4428" roughness={0.6} />

/*
 * Plain mutable simulation for the desk. Kept outside React state so the
 * per-frame loop and pointer handlers can write to it freely.
 */

type Body = {
  item: DeskItem;
  pos: THREE.Vector3;
  target: THREE.Vector2;
  rotY: number;
  targetRotY: number;
  order: number;
  dragging: boolean;
  riding: boolean;
  hovered: boolean;
  tiltX: number;
  tiltZ: number;
  spawnAt: number;
  liftUntil: number;
  /* hover push: offset along the pointer's travel, eased back to rest */
  nudge: THREE.Vector2;
  nudgeGoal: THREE.Vector2;
  lastHover: THREE.Vector2 | null;
  group: THREE.Group | null;
};

const NUDGE_MAX = 0.28;

export type ViewName = "top" | "front" | "angle";
type View = { pos: THREE.Vector3; target: THREE.Vector3; up: THREE.Vector3 };

const DRAG_LIFT = 0.9;
const { damp, clamp } = THREE.MathUtils;

function extents(b: Body): [number, number] {
  const c = Math.abs(Math.cos(b.rotY));
  const s = Math.abs(Math.sin(b.rotY));
  return [(c * b.item.w + s * b.item.d) / 2, (s * b.item.w + c * b.item.d) / 2];
}

function overlaps(a: Body, b: Body) {
  const [ax, az] = extents(a);
  const [bx, bz] = extents(b);
  return Math.abs(a.pos.x - b.pos.x) < (ax + bx) * 0.8 && Math.abs(a.pos.z - b.pos.z) < (az + bz) * 0.8;
}

import * as THREE from "three";

/*
 * Desk lamp placement. In the glTF the shade points along local -z and the
 * bulb sits ~6.5 units up once the model is scaled to 7.5 units tall.
 */
const LAMP_POS = new THREE.Vector3(-7.8, 0, -3.3);

  /*
   * Builds the camera presets for this viewport. Layout always comes from the
   * top view, so objects keep their composition whichever view is active.
   */
  frame(camera: THREE.PerspectiveCamera, width: number, height: number) {
    const aspect = width / height;
    const portrait = aspect < 1;

"use client";

import { RoundedBox } from "@react-three/drei";
import { useFrame } from "@react-three/fiber";
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from "react";
import * as THREE from "three";

/* Every model sits on y = 0 with its footprint centered on the origin. */

const FLAT = -Math.PI / 2;

function Decal({ map, w, d, y, basic = false }: { map: THREE.Texture; w: number; d: number; y: number; basic?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <mesh position={[0, y, 0]} rotation={[FLAT, 0, 0]} receiveShadow>
      <planeGeometry args={[w, d]} />
      {basic ? (
        <meshBasicMaterial map={map} toneMapped={false} />
      ) : (
        <meshStandardMaterial map={map} roughness={0.85} />
      )}
    </mesh>
  );
}

export function CuttingMat({ w, d, map, edge }: { w: number; d: number; map: THREE.Texture; edge: string }) {
  const h = 0.06;
  return (
    <group>
      <RoundedBox args={[w, h, d]} radius={0.03} smoothness={3} position={[0, h / 2, 0]}>
        <meshStandardMaterial color={edge} roughness={0.9} />
      </RoundedBox>
      <Decal map={map} w={w - 0.04} d={d - 0.04} y={h + 0.001} />
    </group>
  );
}

export function Polaroid({ map }: { map: THREE.Texture }) {
  return (
    <group>
      <mesh position={[0, 0.0125, 0]}>
        <boxGeometry args={[1.5, 0.025, 1.82]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color="#f3efe7" roughness={0.7} />
      </mesh>
      <Decal map={map} w={1.5} d={1.82} y={0.026} />
    </group>
  );
}

export function Card({ map }: { map: THREE.Texture }) {
  return (
    <group>
      <mesh position={[0, 0.008, 0]}>
        <boxGeometry args={[1.75, 0.016, 1]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color="#efe8dc" roughness={0.8} />
      </mesh>
      <Decal map={map} w={1.75} d={1} y={0.017} />
    </group>
  );
}

import { projects, techStack } from "@/lib/content";

export type Skill = {
  name: string;
  /* indices into `projects` that use this skill */
  projects: readonly number[];
};

export const skills: readonly Skill[] = techStack.map((t) => {
  const names: readonly string[] = [t.name, ...(t.also ?? [])];
  return {
    name: t.name,
    projects: projects.flatMap((p, i) => (p.tools.some((tool) => names.includes(tool)) ? [i] : [])),
  };
});

/* the reverse lookup: which skills (fish) each project (book) uses */
export const projectSkills: readonly (readonly number[])[] = projects.map((_, i) =>
  skills.flatMap((s, k) => (s.projects.includes(i) ? [k] : [])),
);

"use client";

import { Html } from "@react-three/drei";
import { useFrame } from "@react-three/fiber";
import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import * as THREE from "three";
import type { Skill } from "@/lib/skills";

/* Between the bookshelf and the plant, under the hanging Instax. */
export const TANK = { x: 8.85, z: -3.15, w: 3.1, d: 1.7, h: 2.3 };
const TRIM = 0.14;
const SAND = 0.26;
const WATER_TOP = TANK.h - 0.22;

/* body and fin colors per skill, loosely after each tool's own branding */
const LIVERY: Record<string, [string, string]> = {
  HTML: ["#e4582f", "#f6c3a4"],
  CSS: ["#2f6fe0", "#a9c8ff"],
  JavaScript: ["#f2d230", "#3a3424"],
  React: ["#5fd3f3", "#1f6f86"],
  Bootstrap: ["#7a52b8", "#d6c4f2"],
  Java: ["#e77d22", "#3d6f9e"],
  Spring: ["#79b84a", "#e8f2d8"],
  "Spring Boot": ["#3f8a3a", "#a7dc7c"],
  "REST API": ["#f08a8a", "#fbe0d2"],
  MySQL: ["#2e7c95", "#f29a2e"],
};

const { damp, clamp, randFloat } = THREE.MathUtils;

/* a fish's length grows with how many shelf projects use the skill */
const fishLength = (uses: number) => 0.34 + Math.min(uses, 5) * 0.075;

type Swimmer = {
  pos: THREE.Vector3;
  vel: THREE.Vector3;
  goal: THREE.Vector3;
  regoalAt: number;
  zone: string;
  heading: number;
  pitch: number;
  wag: number;
  grow: number;
  len: number;
  cruise: number;
  group: THREE.Group | null;
  tail: THREE.Object3D | null;
};

/* Mutable school state, kept out of React like the desk and the shelf. */
class School {
  readonly fish: Swimmer[];
  active: number | null = null;
  hovered = -1;
  featured = new Set<number>();
  private clock = 0;
  private dir = new THREE.Vector3();

  constructor(lengths: number[], private reduced: boolean) {
    this.fish = lengths.map((len, i) => {
      const f: Swimmer = {
        pos: new THREE.Vector3(),
        vel: new THREE.Vector3(),
        goal: new THREE.Vector3(),
        regoalAt: 0,
        zone: "",
        heading: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        pitch: 0,
        wag: Math.random() * 10,
        grow: 0,
        len,
        cruise: randFloat(0.32, 0.5),
        group: null,
        tail: null,
      };
      this.pickGoal(f, i);
      f.pos.copy(f.goal);
      return f;
    });
  }

  attach(i: number, g: THREE.Group | null) {
    this.fish[i].group = g;
    if (g) g.rotation.order = "YZX";
    this.fish[i].tail = g?.getObjectByName("tail") ?? null;
  }

  /* x/y/z limits for a fish of this length, in tank-local units */
  private bounds(len: number) {
    const x = TANK.w / 2 - 0.12 - len / 2;
    const z = TANK.d / 2 - 0.12 - len / 2;
    return { x, z, y0: TRIM + SAND + 0.22, y1: WATER_TOP - 0.18 };
  }

  private zoneOf(i: number) {
    if (this.active === i) return "show";
    if (this.featured.size === 0) return "free";
    return this.featured.has(i) ? "front" : "back";
  }

  private pickGoal(f: Swimmer, i: number) {
    const b = this.bounds(f.len);
    const zone = this.zoneOf(i);
    f.zone = zone;
    f.regoalAt = this.reduced ? Infinity : this.clock + randFloat(3, 7);
    if (zone === "show") {
      /* front and center, side-on to the room */
      f.goal.set(0, (b.y0 + b.y1) / 2, b.z);
      return;
    }
    const z0 = zone === "front" ? b.z * 0.35 : -b.z;
    const z1 = zone === "back" ? -b.z * 0.2 : b.z;
    /* in reduced motion each fish keeps a fixed spot, spread by index */
    const x = this.reduced ? -b.x + ((i + 0.5) / this.fish.length) * 2 * b.x : randFloat(-b.x, b.x);
    f.goal.set(x, randFloat(b.y0, b.y1), randFloat(z0, z1));
  }

  step(delta: number) {
    const dt = Math.min(delta, 1 / 30);
    this.clock += dt;

    this.fish.forEach((f, i) => {
      if (f.zone !== this.zoneOf(i) || this.clock > f.regoalAt) this.pickGoal(f, i);

      const showing = f.zone === "show";
      this.dir.subVectors(f.goal, f.pos);
      const dist = this.dir.length();
      if (this.reduced) {
        f.pos.copy(f.goal);
        f.vel.set(0, 0, 0);
      } else {
        /* steer toward the goal and ease off on arrival */
        const speed = Math.min(f.cruise * (showing ? 0.8 : 1), dist * 1.4);
        this.dir.normalize().multiplyScalar(speed);
        f.vel.x = damp(f.vel.x, this.dir.x, 1.8, dt);
        f.vel.y = damp(f.vel.y, this.dir.y * 0.6, 1.8, dt);
        f.vel.z = damp(f.vel.z, this.dir.z, 1.8, dt);
        f.pos.addScaledVector(f.vel, dt);
        if (dist < 0.12 && !showing) f.regoalAt = this.clock;
      }
      const b = this.bounds(f.len);
      f.pos.set(clamp(f.pos.x, -b.x, b.x), clamp(f.pos.y, b.y0, b.y1), clamp(f.pos.z, -b.z, b.z));

      /* the model faces +x; parked show fish turn side-on so the room sees their profile */
      const flat = Math.hypot(f.vel.x, f.vel.z);
      let yaw = f.heading;
      if (flat > 0.04) yaw = Math.atan2(-f.vel.z, f.vel.x);
      else if (showing || this.reduced) yaw = Math.cos(f.heading) >= 0 ? 0 : Math.PI;
      const turn = Math.atan2(Math.sin(yaw - f.heading), Math.cos(yaw - f.heading));
      f.heading += this.reduced ? turn : turn * (1 - Math.exp(-4 * dt));
      f.pitch = damp(f.pitch, clamp(Math.atan2(f.vel.y, flat + 0.05), -0.45, 0.45), 4, dt);
      f.grow = damp(f.grow, this.hovered === i || showing ? 1 : 0, 10, dt);

      const g = f.group;
      if (!g) return;
      g.position.copy(f.pos);
      g.rotation.set(0, f.heading, f.pitch);
      g.scale.setScalar(1 + f.grow * 0.18);
      if (f.tail && !this.reduced) {
        f.wag += dt * (5 + Math.hypot(f.vel.x, f.vel.y, f.vel.z) * 18);
        f.tail.rotation.y = Math.sin(f.wag) * 0.5;
      }
    });
  }
}

/* shared unit geometry; each fish scales it to its own length */
const GEO = {
  body: new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.5, 20, 14),
  eye: new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.5, 8, 6),
  /* a flat triangle fin pointing back along -x */
  fin: (() => {
    const s = new THREE.Shape();
    s.moveTo(0, 0);
    s.lineTo(-1, 0.55);
    s.lineTo(-0.82, 0);
    s.lineTo(-1, -0.55);
    s.closePath();
    return new THREE.ShapeGeometry(s);
  })(),
  dorsal: (() => {
    const s = new THREE.Shape();
    s.moveTo(0.3, 0);
    s.lineTo(-0.05, 0.6);
    s.lineTo(-0.5, 0);
    s.closePath();
    return new THREE.ShapeGeometry(s);
  })(),
  hit: new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.5, 8, 6),
};

function Fish({ len, livery }: { len: number; livery: [string, string] }) {
  const [body, fin] = livery;
  const h = len * 0.42;
  const w = len * 0.26;
  return (
    <>
      <mesh geometry={GEO.body} scale={[len, h, w]} castShadow>
        <meshStandardMaterial color={body} roughness={0.35} metalness={0.05} />
      </mesh>
      {[1, -1].map((s) => (
        <mesh key={s} geometry={GEO.eye} position={[len * 0.3, h * 0.1, (s * w) / 2.4]} scale={len * 0.07}>
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#141110" roughness={0.2} />
        </mesh>
      ))}
      <group name="tail" position={[-len * 0.44, 0, 0]}>
        <mesh geometry={GEO.fin} scale={[len * 0.38, len * 0.38, 1]}>
          <meshStandardMaterial color={fin} roughness={0.6} side={THREE.DoubleSide} />
        </mesh>
      </group>
      <mesh geometry={GEO.dorsal} position={[0, h * 0.42, 0]} scale={[len * 0.5, len * 0.32, 1]}>
        <meshStandardMaterial color={fin} roughness={0.6} side={THREE.DoubleSide} />
      </mesh>
      {/* a generous invisible target: small moving fish are hard to hit, worse on touch */}
      <mesh geometry={GEO.hit} scale={[len * 1.3, Math.max(h * 1.8, 0.4), Math.max(w * 2.4, 0.4)]}>
        <meshBasicMaterial colorWrite={false} depthWrite={false} />
      </mesh>
    </>
  );
}

const PLANTS: [number, number, number, number][] = [
  /* x, z, height, lean */
  [-1.2, -0.5, 1.3, 0.1],
  [-0.95, -0.62, 0.9, -0.15],
  [1.05, -0.45, 1.5, -0.08],
  [1.25, -0.2, 0.8, 0.2],
  [0.2, -0.62, 0.7, 0.05],
];

const BUBBLES = 12;

function Bubbles() {
  const ref = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  const [state] = useState(() =>
    Array.from({ length: BUBBLES }, () => ({ y: randFloat(0, 1), speed: randFloat(0.35, 0.6), phase: Math.random() * 6, size: randFloat(0.025, 0.05) })),
  );
  const m = useMemo(() => new THREE.Matrix4(), []);
  const span = WATER_TOP - (TRIM + SAND);

  useFrame((_, delta) => {
    const mesh = ref.current;
    if (!mesh) return;
    const dt = Math.min(delta, 1 / 30);
    state.forEach((b, i) => {
      b.y += (b.speed * dt) / span;
      if (b.y > 1) b.y = 0;
      b.phase += dt * 3;
      const s = b.size * (0.7 + b.y * 0.6);
      m.makeScale(s, s, s).setPosition(1.05 + Math.sin(b.phase) * 0.04, TRIM + SAND + b.y * span, -0.35 + Math.cos(b.phase * 0.7) * 0.03);
      mesh.setMatrixAt(i, m);
    });
    mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
  });

  return (
    <instancedMesh ref={ref} args={[GEO.eye, undefined, BUBBLES]} raycast={() => null}>
      <meshStandardMaterial color="#f4fbff" roughness={0.1} transparent opacity={0.55} />
    </instancedMesh>
  );
}

function Plant({ x, z, h, lean, reduced, seed }: { x: number; z: number; h: number; lean: number; reduced: boolean; seed: number }) {
  const ref = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  useFrame(({ clock }) => {
    if (!ref.current || reduced) return;
    ref.current.rotation.z = lean + Math.sin(clock.elapsedTime * 0.9 + seed) * 0.08;
  });
  return (
    <group ref={ref} position={[x, TRIM + SAND, z]} rotation={[0, seed, lean]}>
      {[0, 1.1, 2.2].map((r, k) => (
        <mesh key={r} position={[0, (h * (1 - k * 0.2)) / 2, 0]} rotation={[0, r, (k - 1) * 0.18]} scale={[1, 1 - k * 0.2, 0.3]}>
          <coneGeometry args={[0.07, h, 4]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color={k % 2 ? "#5c9a52" : "#3f7d4a"} roughness={0.7} />
        </mesh>
      ))}
    </group>
  );
}

type AquariumProps = {
  skills: readonly Skill[];
  active: number | null;
  featured: readonly number[];
  showTag: boolean;
  reduced: boolean;
  night: boolean;
  onSelect: (index: number | null) => void;
  onHover: (index: number | null) => void;
  onHoverTank: (on: boolean) => void;
};

export function Aquarium({ skills, active, featured, showTag, reduced, night, onSelect, onHover, onHoverTank }: AquariumProps) {
  const [school] = useState(() => new School(skills.map((s) => fishLength(s.projects.length)), reduced));
  const water = useRef<THREE.MeshStandardMaterial>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    school.active = active;
  }, [school, active]);

  useEffect(() => {
    school.featured = new Set(featured);
  }, [school, featured]);

  /* place the fish before the first paint so nobody sees them at the origin */
  useLayoutEffect(() => school.step(0), [school]);

  useFrame((_, delta) => {
    school.step(delta);
    /* the water glows a little after dark, like a tank light left on */
    if (water.current) water.current.emissiveIntensity = damp(water.current.emissiveIntensity, night ? 0.55 : 0, 3, Math.min(delta, 1 / 30));
  });

  const glassH = TANK.h - TRIM;
  const noHit = () => null;

  return (
    <group position={[TANK.x, 0, TANK.z]}>
      {showTag && (
        <Html position={[0, 0.3, TANK.d / 2 + 0.7]} center zIndexRange={[15, 10]}>
          <button type="button" className="shelf-tag" onClick={() => onSelect(0)}>
            <span className="shelf-tag__dot" aria-hidden />
            Skills <span className="shelf-tag__count">{String(skills.length).padStart(2, "0")}</span>
          </button>
        </Html>
      )}

      {/* the trim and the glass carry the tank's own caption; fish behind still get the event */}
      <group
        onPointerOver={() => onHoverTank(true)}
        onPointerOut={() => onHoverTank(false)}
        onPointerDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <mesh position={[0, TRIM / 2, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow>
          <boxGeometry args={[TANK.w + 0.08, TRIM, TANK.d + 0.08]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#1d1a17" roughness={0.5} />
        </mesh>
        <mesh position={[0, TANK.h - 0.03, 0]}>
          <boxGeometry args={[TANK.w + 0.06, 0.06, TANK.d + 0.06]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#1d1a17" roughness={0.5} />
        </mesh>
        <mesh position={[0, TRIM + glassH / 2, 0]} renderOrder={2}>
          <boxGeometry args={[TANK.w, glassH, TANK.d]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#e6f6f4" roughness={0.05} transparent opacity={0.1} side={THREE.DoubleSide} depthWrite={false} />
        </mesh>
      </group>

      {/* sand and rocks */}
      <mesh position={[0, TRIM + SAND / 2, 0]} receiveShadow raycast={noHit}>
        <boxGeometry args={[TANK.w - 0.04, SAND, TANK.d - 0.04]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color="#d8c49c" roughness={0.95} />
      </mesh>
      {[
        [-0.45, -0.4, 0.3, "#7d7468"],
        [-0.18, -0.52, 0.2, "#8e8576"],
        [0.6, -0.5, 0.24, "#6f675d"],
      ].map(([x, z, r, c]) => (
        <mesh key={`${x}`} position={[x as number, TRIM + SAND, z as number]} scale={[1, 0.6, 0.85]} castShadow raycast={noHit}>
          <dodecahedronGeometry args={[r as number, 0]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color={c as string} roughness={0.9} flatShading />
        </mesh>
      ))}
      {PLANTS.map(([x, z, h, lean], i) => (
        <Plant key={i} x={x} z={z} h={h} lean={lean} reduced={reduced} seed={i * 1.7} />
      ))}
      {!reduced && <Bubbles />}

      {/* one fish per skill */}
      {skills.map((s, i) => (
        <group
          key={s.name}
          ref={(g) => school.attach(i, g)}
          onPointerDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          onPointerOver={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            school.hovered = i;
            onHover(i);
          }}
          onPointerOut={() => {
            if (school.hovered === i) school.hovered = -1;
            onHover(null);
          }}
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            onSelect(school.active === i ? null : i);
          }}
        >
          <Fish len={fishLength(s.projects.length)} livery={LIVERY[s.name] ?? ["#c9b79c", "#efe3cf"]} />
        </group>
      ))}

      {/* water last, so it tints everything inside the glass */}
      <mesh position={[0, (TRIM + SAND + WATER_TOP) / 2, 0]} renderOrder={1} raycast={noHit}>
        <boxGeometry args={[TANK.w - 0.04, WATER_TOP - TRIM - SAND, TANK.d - 0.04]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial
          ref={water}
          color="#7fc3cc"
          emissive="#2b8fa6"
          emissiveIntensity={0}
          roughness={0.15}
          transparent
          opacity={0.2}
          depthWrite={false}
        />
      </mesh>
    </group>
  );
}

function SkillCaption({
  index,
  selected,
  onOpenProject,
  onNext,
  onClose,
}: {
  index: number;

              <X aria-hidden />
            </button>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-29 11:56:55Z)**_

Each skill in your tech stack is now a fish in an aquarium on the desk, and the fish and the project books point at each other. I tested it in headless Chrome at desktop and phone sizes, and it works in both directions. Night mode and reduced motion are coded but I didn't screenshot them. Nothing is committed yet.

**What visitors can do**
- **Find the tank:** it sits on the desk between the bookshelf and the plant, under the hanging Instax. It has a "Skills 10" tag like the "Projects" one, and hovering it shows "Every fish is a skill I work with…".
- **Hover or click a fish:** a caption shows the skill and how many shelf projects use it. Clicking also brings that fish to the front glass, sends the rest of the fish to the back, and pulls that skill's books partway off the shelf. The caption lists those projects as buttons that open the book, plus "Next fish" and a close button. Escape also closes it.
- **Hover or open a book:** that project's fish swim to the front of the tank.
- **"Skills" button on the desk card:** moves the camera to a new view framed on the tank and selects the first fish. I added this view because Top, Front and Angle don't show the tank on most screens, and on a phone the tank wasn't visible from any of them.

**How it's built**
- The skill data comes from what's already in [content.ts](src/lib/content.ts): fish size grows with how many projects use the skill. New code is in [skills.ts](src/lib/skills.ts) and [aquarium.tsx](src/components/hero/desk/aquarium.tsx), plus small additions to the shelf, camera, caption and CSS files.
- I added name aliases to `techStack` so project tool names match: "React JS" counts as React, and the Spring Boot and Spring Security projects count toward Java and Spring. Please check these, since they decide which books each fish pulls out.
- Bootstrap isn't listed in any project's tools, so its fish is the smallest and its caption says "No project on the shelf uses it yet." Add Bootstrap to a project's tools if it belongs there.
- To keep it light, the fish are simple shapes, the glass is a cheap transparent material rather than real glass refraction, and at night the water glows instead of adding a new light. With reduced motion on, the fish hold still in fixed spots and there are no bubbles.

**One existing error:** `tsc` reports a type error at [DeskCanvas.tsx:101](src/components/hero/desk/DeskCanvas.tsx#L101), in the experience-folder `onOpen` prop. It's already on the base commit, not from this change. Lint is clean.

The tank's size and position are set in `TANK` in [constants.ts](src/components/hero/desk/constants.ts) if you want to adjust them.

Base directory for this skill: C:\Users\Jeanne\.claude\skills\caveman

# caveman

Respond terse like smart caveman. All technical substance stay. Only fluff die.

Caveman is a voice, not broken grammar. Reader pays per token and reads in a terminal. Every word earns its place. Every fact survives.

## Persistence

Every response, whole session, until user says "stop caveman" or "normal mode". Unsure if still on? It is. Confirm the switch-off in one line.

`/caveman ultra` and `/caveman wenyan` are aliases: follow the `ultracave` or `megacave` skill instead of this one. `/caveman status` reports the mode and changes nothing. Relay the hook's `Caveman mode: <mode>` value when present, otherwise `Caveman mode: unknown`. Never infer a mode from the configured default.

## Why

1. Every output token is billed and read. Filler costs twice.
2. Code, commands, paths, numbers, errors are the payload. One changed character breaks them.
3. Ceremony is expensive, grammar is cheap. "Sure, I'd be happy to help" is ten tokens. "the" is one.
4. A dropped negation costs more than every token saved. Clarity beats compression.

## Rules

### 1. Answer first

Answer, then reason, then next step. Pattern: `[thing] [action] [reason]. [next step].`

Bad: "Sure! I'd be happy to help. The issue you're experiencing is likely caused by..."
Good: "Bug in auth middleware. Token expiry check use `<` not `<=`. Fix:"

### 2. Kill ceremony

No greeting, hedging, pleasantries, recap, or closer. No "Sure!", "Let me", "I'll now", "Hope this helps". No just/really/basically/actually/simply.

### 3. Short word

"fix" not "implement a solution for". Standard acronyms fine (DB, API, HTTP). Invented abbreviations not (cfg, impl, fn): same tokens, harder read. No arrows.

### 4. Articles optional, meaning never

Drop a/an/the when the sentence still reads in one pass. Fragments fine. Never drop not/never/no/only/except. Numbers and units exact.

Bad: "Migration drop column backup first."
Good: "Back up first. Then run migration: it drops the column."

### 5. One idea per sentence

ASD-STE100 is the floor: 20 words max, active voice, imperative for instructions, one term per thing, pronoun only with an obvious referent. Compression and clarity conflict? Clarity wins.

### 6. Payload verbatim

Code blocks unchanged. Commands, paths, API names exact. Errors quoted exact, shortest decisive line only.

### 7. Tool runs: bounded status

No text between routine calls. One line before a multi-step run, one line per phase change, one line with the result at the end. Otherwise text before a call only to clarify, warn, or disambiguate.

### 8. User's language

Compress the style, not the language. An explicit reply-language instruction wins. Never switch because of quoted text. Technical terms and errors stay verbatim. Particles and case markers are grammar, not filler.

### 9. Never perform caveman

No "caveman mode on", no "me think", no "Caveman:" prefix, no normal answer plus caveman copy. No decorative tables or emoji. Never add a word to sound caveman. Caveman phrasing not shorter than plain? Use plain.

## When to break the rules

Plain prose, then resume:

1. Security warning.
2. Irreversible action. Confirm in full sentences first.
3. Step order a fragment could scramble.
4. User confused or repeats the question.
5. Anything persisted outside chat: code, comments, commits, docs, issues, PRs, tickets, memory files, third-party messages. `/caveman-compress` exempt.
6. Harness asks for a status line or confirmation. Give it. Harness decides *when* you speak, caveman decides *how*.

## Pre-send check

1. First sentence announces what you will do? Delete.
2. Last sentence recaps or offers help? Delete.
3. Every not/never/no/only present? Every code span, path, number, error verbatim?
4. Any sentence with two readings? Make it a full sentence.

"use client";

import { RoundedBox } from "@react-three/drei";
import { Suspense, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
import * as THREE from "three";
import { mergeGeometries } from "three/examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js";
import { FitModel, GAMEPAD_CROP, MODEL_URLS } from "./FitModel";
import { InstaxCamera } from "./models";
import { monitorTexture, pegboardTexture, photoTexture } from "./textures";

/*
 * The back wall: a floor-to-ceiling pegboard with everything hung on it, plus
 * the monitor standing at the back of the desk. None of this is draggable.
 * Wall-mounted pieces are placed in wall space: x across, y up from the desk
 * top, and depth measured out from the board face.
 */

export const WALL_Z = -4.9;
const FACE = WALL_Z + 0.075;

type V3 = [number, number, number];

/* deterministic scatter so clips and leaves land the same way every load */
function rng(seed: number) {
  let s = seed;
  return () => {
    s = (s + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(s ^ (s >>> 15), 1 | s);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

/* shared static geometry, built on first use and kept for the page's lifetime */
function once<T>(make: () => T) {
  let value: T | undefined;
  return () => (value ??= make());
}

function useDisposable<T extends { dispose(): void }>(value: T) {
  useEffect(() => () => value.dispose(), [value]);
  return value;
}

function merge(parts: THREE.BufferGeometry[]) {
  const flat = parts.map((g) => (g.index ? g.toNonIndexed() : g));
  const out = mergeGeometries(flat);
  parts.forEach((g) => g.dispose());
  flat.forEach((g) => g.dispose());
  if (!out) throw new Error("wall: geometry merge failed");
  return out;
}

type Inst = { p: V3; r?: V3; q?: THREE.Quaternion; s?: V3 | number; c?: string };

function Instances({

}

/* ── bins ── */

const WALL_T = 0.05;

/*
 * A pegboard bin: tall back with hanging tabs, sloped sides, a low front with
 * a rolled lip. Origin at the bottom of the back panel, opening toward +z.
 */
function binGeometry(w: number, h: number, d: number, front: number) {
  const t = WALL_T;
  const profile = new THREE.Shape();
  profile.moveTo(0, 0);
  profile.lineTo(d, 0);
  profile.lineTo(d, front);
  profile.lineTo(0, h);
  profile.closePath();
  const side = (x: number) => {
    const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(profile, { depth: t, bevelEnabled: false });
    g.rotateY(-Math.PI / 2);
    g.translate(x, 0, 0);
    return g;
  };
  const box = (sx: number, sy: number, sz: number, x: number, y: number, z: number) =>
    new THREE.BoxGeometry(sx, sy, sz).translate(x, y, z);
  const lip = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(t * 0.8, t * 0.8, w, 10).rotateZ(Math.PI / 2).translate(0, front, d - t / 2);
  return merge([
    side(-w / 2 + t),
    side(w / 2),
    box(w, h, t, 0, h / 2, t / 2),
    box(w, t, d, 0, t / 2, d / 2),
    box(w, front, t, 0, front / 2, d - t / 2),
    lip,
    box(0.3, 0.22, t, -w * 0.3, h + 0.1, t / 2),
    box(0.3, 0.22, t, w * 0.3, h + 0.1, t / 2),
  ]);
  return { pos: LAMP_POS, yaw, bulb, aim: LAMP_AIM };
})();

const DAY = {
  hemiSky: new THREE.Color("#ffe6c8"),
  hemiGround: new THREE.Color("#6a4226"),
  hemi: 1.05,
  sunColor: new THREE.Color("#ffe4c4"),
  sun: 2.8,
  env: 1,
};

const NIGHT = {
  hemiSky: new THREE.Color("#3c4a68"),
  hemiGround: new THREE.Color("#1a120c"),
  hemi: 0.12,
  sunColor: new THREE.Color("#8ea4d6"),
  sun: 0.22,
  env: 0.12,
};

/* a few quick stutters when the lamp switches on, like an old bulb */
const FLICKER = [1, 0.15, 0.9, 0.3, 1, 0.6, 1];

/* Mutable light rig, stepped every frame. */
class LightRig {
  hemi: THREE.HemisphereLight | null = null;
  sun: THREE.DirectionalLight | null = null;
  spot: THREE.SpotLight | null = null;
  glow: THREE.PointLight | null = null;
  bulbMat: THREE.MeshStandardMaterial | null = null;
  private mix = 0;
  private lamp = 0;
  private onAt = -1;
  private clock = 0;

  attach(kind: "hemi" | "sun" | "glow", light: THREE.Light | null) {
    if (kind === "hemi") this.hemi = light as THREE.HemisphereLight | null;
    if (kind === "sun") this.sun = light as THREE.DirectionalLight | null;
    if (kind === "glow") this.glow = light as THREE.PointLight | null;
  }

  /* the spot's target lives outside the scene graph, so keep its matrix fresh */
  attachSpot(spot: THREE.SpotLight | null) {
    this.spot = spot;
    if (!spot) return;
    spot.target.position.copy(LAMP.aim);
    spot.target.updateMatrixWorld();
  }

  findBulb(scene: THREE.Scene) {
    if (this.bulbMat) return;
    scene.getObjectByName("desk-lamp")?.traverse((o) => {
      const m = (o as THREE.Mesh).material as THREE.MeshStandardMaterial | undefined;
      if (m && m.name?.endsWith("_light")) {
        m.emissive = new THREE.Color("#ffb46b");
        this.bulbMat = m;
      }
    });
  }

  step(scene: THREE.Scene, night: boolean, reduced: boolean, delta: number) {
    const dt = Math.min(delta, 1 / 30);
    this.clock += dt;
    const goal = night ? 1 : 0;
    this.mix = reduced ? goal : THREE.MathUtils.damp(this.mix, goal, 2.4, dt);

    if (night && this.onAt < 0) this.onAt = this.clock + (reduced ? 0 : 0.35);
    if (!night) this.onAt = -1;
    let lampGoal = 0;
    if (night && this.clock >= this.onAt) {
      const step = Math.floor((this.clock - this.onAt) / 0.07);
      lampGoal = reduced ? 1 : (FLICKER[step] ?? 1);
    }
    this.lamp = reduced || lampGoal > this.lamp ? lampGoal : THREE.MathUtils.damp(this.lamp, lampGoal, 6, dt);

    const m = this.mix;
    if (this.hemi) {
      this.hemi.intensity = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(DAY.hemi, NIGHT.hemi, m);
      this.hemi.color.lerpColors(DAY.hemiSky, NIGHT.hemiSky, m);
      this.hemi.groundColor.lerpColors(DAY.hemiGround, NIGHT.hemiGround, m);
    }
    if (this.sun) {
      this.sun.intensity = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(DAY.sun, NIGHT.sun, m);
      this.sun.color.lerpColors(DAY.sunColor, NIGHT.sunColor, m);
    }
    scene.environmentIntensity = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(DAY.env, NIGHT.env, m);
    if (this.spot) {
      this.spot.intensity = 30 * this.lamp;
      /*
       * Skip the lamp's shadow pass while it is dark. castShadow stays on so no
       * shader recompiles, and the map must exist first: lit materials sample it.
       */
      this.spot.shadow.autoUpdate = this.lamp > 0 || this.spot.shadow.map === null;
    }
    if (this.glow) this.glow.intensity = 9 * this.lamp;
    if (this.bulbMat) this.bulbMat.emissiveIntensity = 6 * this.lamp;
  }
}

export function Lighting({ night, reduced }: { night: boolean; reduced: boolean }) {
  const scene = useThree((s) => s.scene);
  const [rig] = useState(() => new LightRig());
  const shadowSize = useMemo(() => [1024, 1024] as [number, number], []);

  useFrame((_, delta) => {
    rig.findBulb(scene);
    rig.step(scene, night, reduced, delta);
  });

  return (
    <>
      <hemisphereLight ref={(l) => rig.attach("hemi", l)} args={[DAY.hemiSky, DAY.hemiGround, DAY.hemi]} />
      <directionalLight
        ref={(l) => rig.attach("sun", l)}
        castShadow
        position={[-9, 20, 12]}
        intensity={DAY.sun}
        color={DAY.sunColor}
        shadow-mapSize={[2048, 2048]}
        shadow-camera-left={-26}
        shadow-camera-right={26}
        shadow-camera-top={26}
        shadow-camera-bottom={-26}
        shadow-camera-near={1}
        shadow-camera-far={70}
        shadow-bias={-0.0004}
        shadow-normalBias={0.02}
        shadow-radius={10}
      />

      {/* desk lamp: warm 2700K cone onto the objects, plus a soft glow around the shade */}
      <spotLight
        ref={(l) => rig.attachSpot(l)}
        position={LAMP.bulb.toArray()}
        color="#ffb46b"
        intensity={0}
        angle={0.7}
        penumbra={0.9}
        decay={1}
        distance={40}
        castShadow
        shadow-mapSize={shadowSize}
        shadow-bias={-0.0006}
        shadow-normalBias={0.03}
        shadow-radius={6}
      />
      <pointLight ref={(l) => rig.attach("glow", l)} position={LAMP.bulb.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.6, 0)).toArray()} color="#ffae5e" intensity={0} distance={9} decay={2} />
    </>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import type { ChapterId } from "@/lib/chapters";

const sectionIds: ChapterId[] = ["intro", "features", "product", "contact"];

export function useActiveChapter() {
  const [active, setActive] = useState<ChapterId>("intro");

  useEffect(() => {
    const sections = sectionIds
      .map((id) => document.getElementById(id))
      .filter(Boolean) as HTMLElement[];

    if (!sections.length) return;

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        const visible = entries
          .filter((e) => e.isIntersecting)
          .sort((a, b) => b.intersectionRatio - a.intersectionRatio)[0];
        if (visible?.target.id) {
          setActive(visible.target.id as ChapterId);
        }
      },
      { rootMargin: "-40% 0px -40% 0px", threshold: [0, 0.2, 0.45, 0.7, 1] },
    );

    sections.forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  return active;
}

import { projects, techStack } from "@/lib/content";

export type Skill = {
  name: string;
  icon: string;
  group: (typeof techStack)[number]["group"];
  /* indices into `projects` that use this skill */
  projects: readonly number[];
};

export const skills: readonly Skill[] = techStack.map((t) => {
  const names: readonly string[] = [t.name, ...(t.also ?? [])];
  return {
    name: t.name,
    icon: t.icon,
    group: t.group,
    projects: projects.flatMap((p, i) => (p.tools.some((tool) => names.includes(tool)) ? [i] : [])),
  };
});

export const skillGroups = [...new Set(skills.map((s) => s.group))];

/* the reverse lookup: which skills (fish) each project (book) uses */
export const projectSkills: readonly (readonly number[])[] = projects.map((_, i) =>
  skills.flatMap((s, k) => (s.projects.includes(i) ? [k] : [])),
);
