```typescript
"use client";

import { Html } from "@react-three/drei";
import { useFrame } from "@react-three/fiber";
import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import * as THREE from "three";
import { mergeGeometries, mergeVertices } from "three/examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js";
import type { Skill } from "@/lib/skills";
import { TANK } from "./constants";
import { speciesOf, type Species } from "./species";

/*
 * A planted, rimless tank on the L return. Everything here is in tank space:
 * x across the front glass, y up from the desk, z out of the front glass.
 * The group is turned so that front faces the room (+x in world space).
 */

const GLASS = 0.05;
const WATER_TOP = TANK.h - 0.24;
const IN_W = TANK.w - GLASS * 2;
const IN_D = TANK.d - GLASS * 2;
const { damp, clamp, smoothstep } = THREE.MathUtils;

/* deterministic scatter so plants and stones land the same way every load */
function rng(seed: number) {
  let s = seed;
  return () => {
    s = (s + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(s ^ (s >>> 15), 1 | s);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

/* gravel slopes up toward the back, with a mound behind the stones */
function groundY(x: number, z: number) {
  const back = (IN_D / 2 - z) / IN_D;
  return GLASS + 0.26 + 0.42 * Math.pow(clamp(back, 0, 1), 1.3) + 0.16 * Math.exp(-((x + 0.9) ** 2 + (z + 0.35) ** 2) / 0.5);
}

function surface(w: number, h: number) {
  const c = document.createElement("canvas");
  c.width = w;
  c.height = h;
  return { c, ctx: c.getContext("2d")! };
}

function texture(c: HTMLCanvasElement, color = true) {
  const t = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  if (color) t.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  t.wrapS = t.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
  t.anisotropy = 8;
  return t;
}

/* ── skins ── */

function skinTexture(sp: Species) {
  const W = 512;
  const H = 256;
  const { c, ctx } = surface(W, H);
  /* canvas top is the fish's back, left is the nose */
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, sp.back);
  g.addColorStop(0.38, sp.side);
  g.addColorStop(0.64, sp.side);
  g.addColorStop(1, sp.belly);
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  const accent = sp.accent ?? sp.back;
  const bar = (u: number, width: number, alpha: number) => {
    const x = u * W;
    const b = ctx.createLinearGradient(x - width, 0, x + width, 0);
    b.addColorStop(0, "transparent");
    b.addColorStop(0.5, accent);
    b.addColorStop(1, "transparent");
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.fillStyle = b;
    ctx.fillRect(x - width, 0, width * 2, H);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  };

  switch (sp.pattern) {
    case "bars":
      (sp.depth > 0.6 ? [0.13, 0.44, 0.8] : [0.14, 0.34, 0.56, 0.8]).forEach((u) => bar(u, W * 0.035, 0.85));
      break;
    case "slants":
      ctx.strokeStyle = accent;
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8;
      ctx.lineWidth = 9;
      for (let k = 0; k < 15; k++) {
        const x = W * (0.2 + k * 0.053);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(x - 34, H);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    case "stripe": {
      const s = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H * 0.44, 0, H * 0.56);
      s.addColorStop(0, "transparent");
      s.addColorStop(0.5, accent);
      s.addColorStop(1, "transparent");
      ctx.fillStyle = s;
      ctx.fillRect(W * 0.16, H * 0.44, W * 0.84, H * 0.12);
      break;
    }
    case "neon": {
      /* the red flank first, then the electric stripe over it */
      const red = ctx.createLinearGradient(W * 0.45, 0, W * 0.6, 0);
      red.addColorStop(0, "transparent");
      red.addColorStop(1, accent);
      ctx.fillStyle = red;
      ctx.fillRect(W * 0.45, H * 0.52, W * 0.55, H * 0.4);
      ctx.shadowColor = "#7ff2ff";
      ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#38dcff";
      ctx.fillRect(W * 0.13, H * 0.36, W * 0.78, H * 0.09);
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
      break;
    }
    case "waves":
      ctx.strokeStyle = accent;
      ctx.lineWidth = 5;
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85;
      for (let k = 0; k < 10; k++) {
        const y0 = H * (0.1 + k * 0.088);
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 8) ctx.lineTo(x, y0 + Math.sin(x / 38 + k * 1.7) * 6);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    default:
      break;
  }

  /* gill plate, lateral line, darker snout */
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.2)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(W * 0.2, H * 0.5, W * 0.045, H * 0.36, 0, -Math.PI / 2, Math.PI / 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.14)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(W * 0.23, H * 0.42);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(W * 0.6, H * 0.36, W * 0.99, H * 0.5);
  ctx.stroke();
  const snout = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, H * 0.45, 0, 0, H * 0.45, W * 0.16);
  snout.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0.3)");
  snout.addColorStop(1, "transparent");
  ctx.fillStyle = snout;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W * 0.2, H);

  /* scale edging */
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.13)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
  for (let row = 0; row < 16; row++) {
    for (let col = 0; col < 40; col++) {
      const x = W * 0.2 + col * 11 + (row % 2) * 5.5;
      if (x > W) continue;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, row * 16 + 8, 7, -Math.PI / 2, Math.PI / 2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
  return texture(c);
}

/* grey scale relief, shared by every fish as a bump map */
function scaleBump() {
  const { c, ctx } = surface(256, 256);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#808080";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 256, 256);
  for (let row = 0; row < 17; row++) {
    for (let col = 0; col < 17; col++) {
      const x = col * 16 + (row % 2) * 8;
      const y = row * 16;
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x - 3, y, 1, x, y, 10);
      g.addColorStop(0, "#c8c8c8");
      g.addColorStop(0.8, "#7a7a7a");
      g.addColorStop(1, "#505050");
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, y, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  const t = texture(c, false);
  t.repeat.set(5, 2.5);
  return t;
}

/* fin rays, as horizontal lines; fins that need vertical rays swap their uvs */
function finRays() {
  const { c, ctx } = surface(128, 128);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 128);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.22)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
  for (let y = 3; y < 128; y += 7) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, y);
    ctx.lineTo(128, y + 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  return texture(c);
}

/* ── fish geometry ── */

function fishShape(sp: Species) {
  const L = sp.len;
  const Hb = sp.depth * L;
  const profile = (t: number) =>
    Math.max(Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.pow(clamp(t, 0, 1), 0.6)), 0.85), 0.16 * smoothstep(t, 0.55, 1), 0.05);
  return {
    L,
    Hb,
    x: (t: number) => L * (0.5 - t),
    top: (t: number) => (Hb / 2) * 1.08 * profile(t),
    bottom: (t: number) => (Hb / 2) * 0.92 * profile(t),
    half: (t: number) => ((sp.width * L) / 2) * Math.pow(profile(t), 0.9) * (1 - 0.45 * t),
  };
}

function bodyGeometry(sp: Species) {
  const f = fishShape(sp);
  const N = 32;
  const M = 24;
  const pos: number[] = [];
  const uv: number[] = [];
  const idx: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
    const t = i / N;
    for (let j = 0; j <= M; j++) {
      /* the seam runs along the belly, where nobody looks */
      const a = -Math.PI / 2 + (j / M) * Math.PI * 2;
      const s = Math.sin(a);
      pos.push(f.x(t), s * (s > 0 ? f.top(t) : f.bottom(t)), Math.cos(a) * f.half(t));
      uv.push(t, 0.5 + 0.5 * s);
    }
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    for (let j = 0; j < M; j++) {
      const a = i * (M + 1) + j;
      const b = a + M + 1;
      idx.push(a, a + 1, b, b, a + 1, b + 1);
    }
  }
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
  g.setAttribute("uv", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv, 2));
  g.setIndex(idx);
  g.computeVertexNormals();
  return g;
}

function finGeometry(shape: THREE.Shape, swapUV = false) {
  const g = new THREE.ShapeGeometry(shape, 10);
  g.computeBoundingBox();
  const b = g.boundingBox!;
  const p = g.attributes.position;
  const uv = g.attributes.uv;
  for (let i = 0; i < p.count; i++) {
    const u = (p.getX(i) - b.min.x) / (b.max.x - b.min.x || 1);
    const v = (p.getY(i) - b.min.y) / (b.max.y - b.min.y || 1);
    if (swapUV) uv.setXY(i, v, u);
    else uv.setXY(i, u, v);
  }
  return g;
}

function finsGeometry(sp: Species) {
  const f = fishShape(sp);
  const { L, Hb } = f;
  const parts: THREE.BufferGeometry[] = [];

  /* caudal */
  const x0 = -L / 2 + 0.01;
  const ph = f.top(0.97);
  const tail = new THREE.Shape();
  if (sp.tail === "fork") {
    const tl = L * 0.32;
    const S = Hb * 0.52;
    tail.moveTo(x0, ph);
    tail.quadraticCurveTo(x0 - tl * 0.5, S * 0.7, x0 - tl, S);
    tail.lineTo(x0 - tl * 0.55, 0);
    tail.lineTo(x0 - tl, -S);
    tail.quadraticCurveTo(x0 - tl * 0.5, -S * 0.7, x0, -ph);
  } else if (sp.tail === "veil") {
    const tl = L * 0.75;
    const S = Hb * 0.95;
    tail.moveTo(x0, ph);
    tail.bezierCurveTo(x0 - tl * 0.3, S * 0.9, x0 - tl * 0.8, S, x0 - tl, S * 0.5);
    tail.quadraticCurveTo(x0 - tl * 1.1, -S * 0.3, x0 - tl * 0.8, -S * 0.9);
    tail.bezierCurveTo(x0 - tl * 0.5, -S, x0 - tl * 0.2, -S * 0.6, x0, -ph);
  } else if (sp.tail === "sword") {
    const tl = L * 0.28;
    const S = Hb * 0.5;
    tail.moveTo(x0, ph);
    tail.quadraticCurveTo(x0 - tl * 0.4, S * 0.9, x0 - tl, S * 0.8);
    tail.lineTo(x0 - tl, -S * 0.2);
    tail.lineTo(x0 - tl * 2.4, -S * 0.75);
    tail.lineTo(x0 - tl * 2.3, -S * 0.98);
    tail.quadraticCurveTo(x0 - tl * 0.6, -S * 0.9, x0, -ph);
  } else if (sp.tail === "lyre") {
    const tl = L * 0.42;
    const S = Hb * 0.6;
    tail.moveTo(x0, ph);
    tail.quadraticCurveTo(x0 - tl * 0.4, S * 0.6, x0 - tl * 1.4, S * 1.1);
    tail.quadraticCurveTo(x0 - tl * 0.7, S * 0.25, x0 - tl * 0.55, 0);
    tail.quadraticCurveTo(x0 - tl * 0.7, -S * 0.25, x0 - tl * 1.4, -S * 1.1);
    tail.quadraticCurveTo(x0 - tl * 0.4, -S * 0.6, x0, -ph);
  } else {
    const tl = L * 0.3;
    const S = Hb * 0.48;
    tail.moveTo(x0, ph);
    tail.quadraticCurveTo(x0 - tl * 0.4, S * 0.9, x0 - tl, S * 0.85);
    tail.quadraticCurveTo(x0 - tl * 1.15, 0, x0 - tl, -S * 0.85);
    tail.quadraticCurveTo(x0 - tl * 0.4, -S * 0.9, x0, -ph);
  }
  parts.push(finGeometry(tail));

  /* dorsal and anal: a leading edge that rises, a trailing tip that sweeps back */
  const median = ([t0, t1, h]: [number, number, number], dir: 1 | -1) => {
    const edge = dir > 0 ? f.top : f.bottom;
    const xa = f.x(t0);
    const xb = f.x(t1);
    const ya = dir * edge(t0) * 0.82;
    const yb = dir * edge(t1) * 0.82;
    const span = xa - xb;
    const hp = dir * h * Hb;
    const e = dir * 0.02;
    const s = new THREE.Shape();
    s.moveTo(xa, ya - e);
    s.quadraticCurveTo(xa, ya + hp * 0.9, xa - span * 0.35, (dir > 0 ? Math.max(ya, yb) : Math.min(ya, yb)) + hp);
    s.quadraticCurveTo(xb - span * 0.1, yb + hp * 0.7, xb - L * 0.12 * h, yb + hp * 0.15);
    s.quadraticCurveTo(xb, yb, xb, yb - e);
    s.closePath();
    return finGeometry(s, true);
  };
  parts.push(median(sp.dorsal, 1), median(sp.anal, -1));

  /* paired fins, angled out from the flanks */
  const paired = (t: number, size: number, drop: number, yaw: number, roll: number) => {
    const s = new THREE.Shape();
    s.moveTo(0, 0);
    s.quadraticCurveTo(-size * 0.5, size * 0.35, -size, size * 0.1);
    s.quadraticCurveTo(-size * 0.6, -size * 0.25, 0, -size * 0.1);
    [1, -1].forEach((side) => {
      const g = finGeometry(s);
      g.rotateZ(roll);
      g.rotateY(side * yaw);
      g.translate(f.x(t), -f.bottom(t) * drop, side * f.half(t) * 0.9);
      parts.push(g);
    });
  };
  paired(0.27, L * 0.16, 0.35, 0.55, -0.15);
  paired(0.4, L * 0.12, 0.9, 0.25, -0.6);

  const flat = parts.map((p) => p.toNonIndexed());
  const merged = mergeGeometries(flat);
  parts.forEach((p) => p.dispose());
  flat.forEach((p) => p.dispose());
  if (!merged) throw new Error("aquarium: fin merge failed");
  return merged;
}

/* ── swimming ── */

type Bend = {
  uPhase: { value: number };
  uAmp: { value: number };
  uHead: { value: number };
  uLen: { value: number };
  uK: { value: number };
};

/* bends the body and fins as a travelling wave, growing toward the tail */
function bendable<T extends THREE.Material>(m: T, u: Bend) {
  m.onBeforeCompile = (shader) => {
    Object.assign(shader.uniforms, u);
    shader.vertexShader = shader.vertexShader
      .replace("#include <common>", "#include <common>\nuniform float uPhase, uAmp, uHead, uLen, uK;")
      .replace(
        "#include <begin_vertex>",
        `#include <begin_vertex>
float bendS = clamp((uHead - transformed.x) / uLen, 0.0, 1.8);
transformed.z += uAmp * bendS * bendS * sin(uPhase - transformed.x * uK);`,
      );
  };
  m.customProgramCacheKey = () => "fish-bend";
  return m;
}

type Swimmer = {
  sp: Species;
  pos: THREE.Vector3;
  vel: THREE.Vector3;
  goal: THREE.Vector3;
  regoalAt: number;
  zone: string;
  heading: number;
  pitch: number;
  grow: number;
  cruise: number;
  bend: Bend;
  group: THREE.Group | null;
};

/* Mutable school state, kept out of React like the desk and the shelf. */
class School {
  readonly fish: Swimmer[];
  active: number | null = null;
  hovered = -1;
  featured = new Set<number>();
  private clock = 0;
  private dir = new THREE.Vector3();
  private rand = rng(7);

  constructor(species: Species[], private reduced: boolean) {
    this.fish = species.map((sp, i) => {
      const f: Swimmer = {
        sp,
        pos: new THREE.Vector3(),
        vel: new THREE.Vector3(),
        goal: new THREE.Vector3(),
        regoalAt: 0,
        zone: "",
        heading: this.rand() * Math.PI * 2,
        pitch: 0,
        grow: 0,
        cruise: 0.28 + this.rand() * 0.2,
        bend: {
          uPhase: { value: this.rand() * 10 },
          uAmp: { value: 0 },
          uHead: { value: sp.len * 0.22 },
          uLen: { value: sp.len },
          uK: { value: (Math.PI * 2) / (sp.len * 1.25) },
        },
        group: null,
      };
      this.pickGoal(f, i);
      f.pos.copy(f.goal);
      return f;
    });
  }

  setActive(i: number | null) {
    this.active = i;
  }

  setFeatured(indices: readonly number[]) {
    this.featured = new Set(indices);
  }

  setHovered(i: number) {
    this.hovered = i;
  }

  attach(i: number, g: THREE.Group | null) {
    this.fish[i].group = g;
    if (g) g.rotation.order = "YZX";
  }

  private bounds(len: number) {
    return { x: IN_W / 2 - 0.12 - len / 2, z: IN_D / 2 - 0.1 - len / 2, y1: WATER_TOP - 0.22 };
  }

  private zoneOf(i: number) {
    if (this.active === i) return "show";
    /* the rest of the school makes room for the one on show */
    if (this.active !== null) return "back";
    if (this.featured.size === 0) return "free";
    return this.featured.has(i) ? "front" : "back";
  }

  private floor(f: Swimmer) {
    return groundY(f.pos.x, f.pos.z) + f.sp.depth * f.sp.len * 0.6 + 0.08;
  }

  private pickGoal(f: Swimmer, i: number) {
    const b = this.bounds(f.sp.len);
    const zone = this.zoneOf(i);
    f.zone = zone;
    f.regoalAt = this.reduced ? Infinity : this.clock + 3 + this.rand() * 4;
    if (zone === "show") {
      /* front and center, side-on to the room */
      f.goal.set(0, (WATER_TOP + groundY(0, b.z)) / 2, b.z);
      return;
    }
    const z0 = zone === "front" ? b.z * 0.3 : -b.z;
    const z1 = zone === "back" ? -b.z * 0.15 : b.z;
    /* in reduced motion each fish keeps a fixed spot, spread by index */
    const x = this.reduced ? -b.x + ((i + 0.5) / this.fish.length) * 2 * b.x : -b.x + this.rand() * 2 * b.x;
    const z = z0 + this.rand() * (z1 - z0);
    const y0 = groundY(x, z) + 0.3;
    f.goal.set(x, y0 + this.rand() * Math.max(0, b.y1 - y0), z);
  }

  step(delta: number) {
    const dt = Math.min(delta, 1 / 30);
    this.clock += dt;

    this.fish.forEach((f, i) => {
      if (f.zone !== this.zoneOf(i) || this.clock > f.regoalAt) this.pickGoal(f, i);

      const showing = f.zone === "show";
      this.dir.subVectors(f.goal, f.pos);
      const dist = this.dir.length();
      if (this.reduced) {
        f.pos.copy(f.goal);
        f.vel.set(0, 0, 0);
      } else {
        /* steer toward the goal and ease off on arrival */
        const speed = Math.min(f.cruise * (showing ? 0.8 : 1), dist * 1.4);
        this.dir.normalize().multiplyScalar(speed);
        f.vel.x = damp(f.vel.x, this.dir.x, 1.8, dt);
        f.vel.y = damp(f.vel.y, this.dir.y * 0.6, 1.8, dt);
        f.vel.z = damp(f.vel.z, this.dir.z, 1.8, dt);
        f.pos.addScaledVector(f.vel, dt);
        if (dist < 0.12 && !showing) f.regoalAt = this.clock;
      }
      const b = this.bounds(f.sp.len);
      f.pos.x = clamp(f.pos.x, -b.x, b.x);
      f.pos.z = clamp(f.pos.z, -b.z, b.z);
      f.pos.y = clamp(f.pos.y, this.floor(f), b.y1);

      /* the model faces +x; a parked fish turns side-on so the room sees its profile */
      const flat = Math.hypot(f.vel.x, f.vel.z);
      let yaw = f.heading;
      if (flat > 0.04) yaw = Math.atan2(-f.vel.z, f.vel.x);
      else if (showing || this.reduced) yaw = Math.cos(f.heading) >= 0 ? 0 : Math.PI;
      const turn = Math.atan2(Math.sin(yaw - f.heading), Math.cos(yaw - f.heading));
      f.heading += this.reduced ? turn : turn * (1 - Math.exp(-4 * dt));
      f.pitch = damp(f.pitch, clamp(Math.atan2(f.vel.y, flat + 0.05), -0.4, 0.4), 4, dt);
      f.grow = damp(f.grow, this.hovered === i || showing ? 1 : 0, 10, dt);

      /* tail beat speeds up with swimming speed; a hovering fish still sculls */
      const pace = Math.min(f.vel.length() / 0.4, 1);
      f.bend.uPhase.value += dt * (5 + pace * 9);
      f.bend.uAmp.value = this.reduced ? 0 : f.sp.len * (0.05 + pace * 0.09) + Math.abs(turn) * f.sp.len * 0.08;

      const g = f.group;
      if (!g) return;
      g.position.copy(f.pos);
      g.rotation.set(0, f.heading, f.pitch);
      g.scale.setScalar(1 + f.grow * 0.12);
    });
  }
}

function Fish({ sp, bend, bump, rays }: { sp: Species; bend: Bend; bump: THREE.Texture; rays: THREE.Texture }) {
  const parts = useMemo(() => {
    const body = bodyGeometry(sp);
    const fins = finsGeometry(sp);
    const skin = skinTexture(sp);
    const bodyMat = bendable(
      new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
        map: skin,
        bumpMap: bump,
        bumpScale: 0.6,
        roughness: 0.38,
        clearcoat: 0.6,
        clearcoatRoughness: 0.3,
        iridescence: sp.sheen,
        iridescenceIOR: 1.35,
        iridescenceThicknessRange: [180, 520],
      }),
      bend,
    );
    const finMat = bendable(
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        map: rays,
        color: sp.fin,
        roughness: 0.5,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: sp.finAlpha,
        side: THREE.DoubleSide,
        depthWrite: false,
      }),
      bend,
    );
    return { body, fins, skin, bodyMat, finMat };
  }, [sp, bend, bump, rays]);

  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      parts.body.dispose();
      parts.fins.dispose();
      parts.skin.dispose();
      parts.bodyMat.dispose();
      parts.finMat.dispose();
    },
    [parts],
  );

  const f = fishShape(sp);
  const t = 0.12;
  const er = Math.min(f.Hb * 0.11, sp.len * 0.075);
  return (
    <>
      <mesh geometry={parts.body} material={parts.bodyMat} />
      <mesh geometry={parts.fins} material={parts.finMat} renderOrder={3} />
      {[1, -1].map((s) => (
        <group key={s} position={[f.x(t), f.top(t) * 0.28, s * f.half(t) * 0.86]}>
          <mesh scale={[1, 1, 0.55]}>
            <sphereGeometry args={[er, 14, 10]} />
            <meshPhysicalMaterial color="#060606" roughness={0.1} clearcoat={1} />
          </mesh>
          <mesh position={[0, 0, s * er * 0.32]}>
            <torusGeometry args={[er * 0.62, er * 0.24, 8, 18]} />
            <meshStandardMaterial color={sp.iris} roughness={0.35} metalness={0.3} />
          </mesh>
        </group>
      ))}
      {/* a generous invisible target: small moving fish are hard to hit, worse on touch */}
      <mesh scale={[sp.len * 1.4, Math.max(f.Hb * 1.6, 0.4), Math.max(sp.width * sp.len * 3, 0.4)]}>
        <sphereGeometry args={[0.5, 8, 6]} />
        <meshBasicMaterial colorWrite={false} depthWrite={false} />
      </mesh>
    </>
  );
}

/* ── the tank's furnishings ── */

function gravelTexture() {
  const S = 512;
  const { c, ctx } = surface(S, S);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#5e5142";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, S, S);
  const r = rng(11);
  const palette = ["#8b7b64", "#5e5243", "#a8987c", "#6f665c", "#c2b49a", "#4a4038", "#9a8c78"];
  for (let i = 0; i < 5200; i++) {
    const x = r() * S;
    const y = r() * S;
    const rad = 2 + r() * 5;
    const rot = r() * Math.PI;
    const col = palette[Math.floor(r() * palette.length)];
    /* wrap pebbles over the edges so the texture tiles */
    for (const [dx, dy] of [[0, 0], [S, 0], [-S, 0], [0, S], [0, -S]]) {
      const px = x + dx;
      const py = y + dy;
      if (px < -8 || px > S + 8 || py < -8 || py > S + 8) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(px + 1, py + 1.2, rad, rad * 0.75, rot, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = col;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(px, py, rad, rad * 0.75, rot, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.18)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(px - rad * 0.3, py - rad * 0.3, rad * 0.35, rad * 0.25, rot, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  const t = texture(c);
  t.repeat.set(3, 1.4);
  return t;
}

/* tiling caustic net: where the two nearest cell seeds are almost equidistant */
function causticTexture() {
  const S = 256;
  const { c, ctx } = surface(S, S);
  const r = rng(5);
  const seeds = Array.from({ length: 22 }, () => [r() * S, r() * S]);
  const img = ctx.createImageData(S, S);
  for (let y = 0; y < S; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < S; x++) {
      let d1 = Infinity;
      let d2 = Infinity;
      for (const [sx, sy] of seeds) {
        let dx = Math.abs(x - sx);
        let dy = Math.abs(y - sy);
        dx = Math.min(dx, S - dx);
        dy = Math.min(dy, S - dy);
        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
        if (d < d1) {
          d2 = d1;
          d1 = d;
        } else if (d < d2) d2 = d;
      }
      const v = Math.pow(1 - smoothstep(d2 - d1, 0, 9), 2) * 255;
      const k = (y * S + x) * 4;
      img.data[k] = img.data[k + 1] = img.data[k + 2] = v;
      img.data[k + 3] = 255;
    }
  }
  ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
  const t = texture(c);
  t.repeat.set(2.2, 1);
  return t;
}

function stoneTexture() {
  const S = 256;
  const { c, ctx } = surface(S, S);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#7f807b";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, S, S);
  const r = rng(23);
  for (let i = 0; i < 2600; i++) {
    const v = 90 + r() * 70;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${v},${v},${v - 6},0.5)`;
    ctx.fillRect(r() * S, r() * S, 1 + r() * 3, 1 + r() * 3);
  }
  /* the pale calcite veins of seiryu stone */
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(235,232,222,0.55)";
  for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
    ctx.lineWidth = 1 + r() * 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    let x = r() * S;
    let y = r() * S;
    ctx.moveTo(x, y);
    for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
      x += (r() - 0.3) * 60;
      y += (r() - 0.5) * 40;
      ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  return texture(c);
}

function barkTexture() {
  const { c, ctx } = surface(512, 64);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4a3222";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 64);
  const r = rng(31);
  for (let i = 0; i < 160; i++) {
    const v = r();
    ctx.strokeStyle = v > 0.6 ? "rgba(140,104,72,0.55)" : "rgba(26,16,10,0.5)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.8 + r() * 2.2;
    const y = r() * 64;
    const x = r() * 512;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 40 + r() * 160, y + (r() - 0.5) * 4);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  return texture(c);
}

function filmTexture() {
  const { c, ctx } = surface(64, 256);
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 256);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#16353b");
  g.addColorStop(0.6, "#0b1d20");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#060e0f");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 256);
  return texture(c);
}

function stoneGeometry(seed: number) {
  const r = rng(seed);
  const waves = Array.from({ length: 7 }, () => ({
    d: new THREE.Vector3(r() - 0.5, r() - 0.5, r() - 0.5).normalize(),
    f: 1.5 + r() * 4,
    p: r() * 6.28,
    a: 0.03 + r() * 0.07,
  }));
  const base = new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 4);
  base.deleteAttribute("normal");
  base.deleteAttribute("uv");
  const g = mergeVertices(base);
  base.dispose();
  const p = g.attributes.position;
  const n = new THREE.Vector3();
  const uv: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < p.count; i++) {
    n.fromBufferAttribute(p, i).normalize();
    const k = 1 + waves.reduce((s, w) => s + Math.sin(n.dot(w.d) * w.f + w.p) * w.a, 0);
    /* flatten the base so stones sit into the gravel */
    p.setXYZ(i, n.x * k, Math.max(n.y * k, -0.35), n.z * k);
    uv.push(0.5 + Math.atan2(n.z, n.x) / (Math.PI * 2), 0.5 + n.y * 0.5);
  }
  g.setAttribute("uv", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv, 2));
  g.computeVertexNormals();
  return g;
}

/* every grass blade and stem leaf in the tank, merged into one swaying mesh */
function plantsGeometry() {
  const r = rng(41);
  const blades: THREE.BufferGeometry[] = [];
  const col = new THREE.Color();
  const blade = (x: number, z: number, len: number, width: number, curl: number, base: string, tip: string) => {
    const g = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(width, len, 1, 6);
    g.translate(0, len / 2, 0);
    const p = g.attributes.position;
    const h = new Float32Array(p.count);
    const phase = new Float32Array(p.count).fill(r() * 6.28);
    const colors = new Float32Array(p.count * 3);
    const c0 = new THREE.Color(base);
    const c1 = new THREE.Color(tip);
    for (let i = 0; i < p.count; i++) {
      const t = p.getY(i) / len;
      p.setX(i, p.getX(i) * (1 - t * 0.7) + curl * t * t * len * 0.35);
      p.setZ(i, Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 0.04 * curl);
      h[i] = (t * len) / 2.4;
      col.lerpColors(c0, c1, t);
      colors.set([col.r, col.g, col.b], i * 3);
    }
    g.setAttribute("aH", new THREE.BufferAttribute(h, 1));
    g.setAttribute("aPhase", new THREE.BufferAttribute(phase, 1));
    g.setAttribute("color", new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
    g.rotateY(r() * Math.PI * 2);
    g.translate(x, groundY(x, z) - 0.03, z);
    blades.push(g);
  };

  /* vallisneria along the back, tall enough to reach the surface */
  for (let i = 0; i < 46; i++) {
    const x = -IN_W / 2 + 0.2 + r() * (IN_W - 0.4);
    const z = -IN_D / 2 + 0.12 + r() * 0.45;
    const room = WATER_TOP - groundY(x, z);
    blade(x, z, room * (0.6 + r() * 0.45), 0.055, (r() - 0.5) * 1.6, "#24502a", "#7bb04c");
  }
  /* rotala bushes in the back corners, red at the tips */
  for (const cx of [-IN_W / 2 + 0.45, IN_W / 2 - 0.5]) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
      const a = r() * Math.PI * 2;
      const d = Math.sqrt(r()) * 0.38;
      blade(cx + Math.cos(a) * d, -0.25 + Math.sin(a) * d * 0.8, 0.5 + r() * 0.9, 0.04, (r() - 0.5) * 2, "#3b6a2e", r() > 0.4 ? "#c8644a" : "#8fbf52");
    }
  }
  /* dwarf hairgrass carpet across the front */
  for (let i = 0; i < 320; i++) {
    const x = -IN_W / 2 + 0.1 + r() * (IN_W - 0.2);
    const z = r() * (IN_D / 2 - 0.12);
    blade(x, z, 0.1 + r() * 0.16, 0.014, (r() - 0.5) * 2, "#2f6a2c", "#8ccc5a");
  }
  const merged = mergeGeometries(blades);
  blades.forEach((b) => b.dispose());
  if (!merged) throw new Error("aquarium: plant merge failed");
  return merged;
}

function swaying(m: THREE.MeshStandardMaterial, time: { value: number }) {
  m.onBeforeCompile = (shader) => {
    shader.uniforms.uTime = time;
    shader.vertexShader = shader.vertexShader
      .replace("#include <common>", "#include <common>\nattribute float aH;\nattribute float aPhase;\nuniform float uTime;")
      .replace(
        "#include <begin_vertex>",
        `#include <begin_vertex>
float sway = aH * aH;
transformed.x += sin(uTime * 0.8 + aPhase) * 0.12 * sway;
transformed.z += cos(uTime * 0.6 + aPhase * 1.3) * 0.06 * sway;`,
      );
  };
  m.customProgramCacheKey = () => "plant-sway";
  return m;
}

/* the gravel bed, plus its cut face seen through the front and side glass */
function groundGeometry() {
  const top = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(IN_W, IN_D, 64, 32).rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
  const p = top.attributes.position;
  const r = rng(3);
  for (let i = 0; i < p.count; i++) p.setY(i, groundY(p.getX(i), p.getZ(i)) + (r() - 0.5) * 0.02);
  top.computeVertexNormals();

  const skirt = (along: "x" | "z", fixed: number, flip: boolean) => {
    const n = 48;
    const len = along === "x" ? IN_W : IN_D;
    const pos: number[] = [];
    const uv: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
      const s = -len / 2 + (i / n) * len;
      const [x, z] = along === "x" ? [s, fixed] : [fixed, s];
      const y = groundY(x, z);
      pos.push(x, y, z, x, GLASS, z);
      uv.push(i / n, y / 0.4, i / n, 0);
    }
    const idx: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = i * 2;
      if (flip) idx.push(a, a + 2, a + 1, a + 1, a + 2, a + 3);
      else idx.push(a, a + 1, a + 2, a + 1, a + 3, a + 2);
    }
    const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
    g.setAttribute("uv", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv, 2));
    g.setIndex(idx);
    g.computeVertexNormals();
    return g;
  };
  const parts = [top, skirt("x", IN_D / 2, false), skirt("z", -IN_W / 2, false), skirt("z", IN_W / 2, true)];
  const flat = parts.map((g) => g.toNonIndexed());
  const merged = mergeGeometries(flat);
  parts.forEach((g) => g.dispose());
  flat.forEach((g) => g.dispose());
  if (!merged) throw new Error("aquarium: ground merge failed");
  return merged;
}

const DRIFTWOOD: [number, number, number][][] = [
  [[-1.5, 0.55, 0.2], [-1.0, 0.75, -0.05], [-0.45, 1.25, -0.35], [0.1, 1.85, -0.55]],
  [[-1.0, 0.75, -0.05], [-1.35, 1.3, -0.3], [-1.6, 1.75, -0.45]],
  [[-0.45, 1.25, -0.35], [-0.2, 1.45, -0.1], [0.2, 1.5, 0.05]],
];

/* glass panes: clear faces, with the green tint showing only on the cut edges */
function Pane({ size, at, thin }: { size: [number, number, number]; at: [number, number, number]; thin: 0 | 1 | 2 }) {
  return (
    <mesh position={at} renderOrder={4} raycast={() => null}>
      <boxGeometry args={size} />
      {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((k) =>
        Math.floor(k / 2) === thin ? (
          <meshStandardMaterial key={k} attach={`material-${k}`} color="#f1fbf8" roughness={0.02} metalness={0.1} envMapIntensity={2} transparent opacity={0.07} depthWrite={false} />
        ) : (
          <meshStandardMaterial key={k} attach={`material-${k}`} color="#7cc4a9" roughness={0.1} transparent opacity={0.6} depthWrite={false} />
        ),
      )}
    </mesh>
  );
}

function Bubbles() {
  const count = 18;
  const ref = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  const [state] = useState(() => {
    const r = rng(17);
    return Array.from({ length: count }, () => ({ y: r(), speed: 0.4 + r() * 0.35, phase: r() * 6, size: 0.018 + r() * 0.03 }));
  });
  const m = useMemo(() => new THREE.Matrix4(), []);
  const x = IN_W / 2 - 0.35;
  const z = -IN_D / 2 + 0.25;
  const base = groundY(x, z);
  const span = WATER_TOP - base;

  useFrame((_, delta) => {
    const mesh = ref.current;
    if (!mesh) return;
    const dt = Math.min(delta, 1 / 30);
    state.forEach((b, i) => {
      b.y += (b.speed * dt) / span;
      if (b.y > 1) b.y = 0;
      b.phase += dt * 3;
      const s = b.size * (0.7 + b.y * 0.6);
      m.makeScale(s, s, s).setPosition(x + Math.sin(b.phase) * 0.03, base + b.y * span, z + Math.cos(b.phase * 0.7) * 0.03);
      mesh.setMatrixAt(i, m);
    });
    mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
  });

  return (
    <instancedMesh ref={ref} args={[undefined, undefined, count]} raycast={() => null}>
      <sphereGeometry args={[1, 10, 8]} />
      <meshStandardMaterial color="#f4fbff" roughness={0.05} transparent opacity={0.5} />
    </instancedMesh>
  );
}

const STONES: [number, number, number, [number, number, number], number][] = [
  /* x, z, yaw, scale, geometry */
  [-0.85, -0.35, 0.4, [0.5, 0.62, 0.4], 0],
  [-0.25, -0.15, 1.6, [0.3, 0.32, 0.26], 1],
  [0.55, -0.4, 2.4, [0.38, 0.4, 0.3], 2],
  [1.2, 0.1, 0.8, [0.2, 0.16, 0.18], 3],
];

type AquariumProps = {
  skills: readonly Skill[];
  active: number | null;
  featured: readonly number[];
  /* the fish wearing a name tag: hovered in the guide or the tank, or selected */
  labelled: number | null;
  reduced: boolean;
  night: boolean;
  onSelect: (index: number | null) => void;
  onHover: (index: number | null) => void;
};

export function Aquarium({ skills, active, featured, labelled, reduced, night, onSelect, onHover }: AquariumProps) {
  const species = useMemo(() => skills.map((s) => speciesOf(s.name)), [skills]);
  const [school] = useState(() => new School(species, reduced));
  const time = useMemo(() => ({ value: 0 }), []);
  const groundMat = useRef<THREE.MeshStandardMaterial>(null);
  const light = useRef<THREE.SpotLight>(null);
  const label = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);

  const tex = useMemo(
    () => ({
      bump: scaleBump(),
      rays: finRays(),
      gravel: gravelTexture(),
      caustic: causticTexture(),
      stone: stoneTexture(),
      bark: barkTexture(),
      film: filmTexture(),
    }),
    [],
  );
  const geo = useMemo(
    () => ({
      ground: groundGeometry(),
      plants: plantsGeometry(),
      stones: [stoneGeometry(1), stoneGeometry(2), stoneGeometry(3), stoneGeometry(4)],
      wood: DRIFTWOOD.map((pts, i) => new THREE.TubeGeometry(new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts.map((p) => new THREE.Vector3(...p))), 40, 0.09 - i * 0.02, 8)),
    }),
    [],
  );
  const plantMat = useMemo(
    () => swaying(new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, side: THREE.DoubleSide, roughness: 0.55 }), time),
    [time],
  );

  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      Object.values(tex).forEach((t) => t.dispose());
      geo.ground.dispose();
      geo.plants.dispose();
      geo.stones.forEach((g) => g.dispose());
      geo.wood.forEach((g) => g.dispose());
      plantMat.dispose();
    },
    [tex, geo, plantMat],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    school.setActive(active);
  }, [school, active]);

  useEffect(() => {
    school.setFeatured(featured);
  }, [school, featured]);

  /* place the fish before the first paint so nobody sees them at the origin */
  useLayoutEffect(() => school.step(0), [school]);

  /* the light's target lives outside the scene graph, so keep its matrix fresh */
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const l = light.current;
    if (!l) return;
    l.target.position.set(TANK.x, 0, TANK.z);
    l.target.updateMatrixWorld();
  }, []);

  useFrame((_, delta) => {
    const dt = Math.min(delta, 1 / 30);
    school.step(delta);
    if (!reduced) {
      time.value += dt;
      /* caustics drift across the gravel */
      tex.caustic.offset.x += dt * 0.012;
      tex.caustic.offset.y += dt * 0.008;
    }
    /* the tank light reads brighter once the room goes dark */
    if (groundMat.current) groundMat.current.emissiveIntensity = damp(groundMat.current.emissiveIntensity, night ? 0.55 : 0.22, 3, dt);
    if (light.current) light.current.intensity = damp(light.current.intensity, night ? 26 : 12, 3, dt);
    if (label.current && labelled !== null) {
      const f = school.fish[labelled];
      label.current.position.set(f.pos.x, f.pos.y + f.sp.depth * f.sp.len * 0.5 + 0.16, f.pos.z);
    }
  });

  const glassH = TANK.h - GLASS;
  const noHit = () => null;

  return (
    <>
      {/* the light bar's spot, in world space so its target is easy to aim */}
      <spotLight ref={light} position={[TANK.x, TANK.h + 0.2, TANK.z]} color="#eef7ff" intensity={12} angle={1.05} penumbra={0.7} decay={1.4} distance={7} />

      <group position={[TANK.x, 0, TANK.z]} rotation={[0, Math.PI / 2, 0]}>
        {/* leveling mat */}
        <mesh position={[0, 0.01, 0]} receiveShadow raycast={noHit}>
          <boxGeometry args={[TANK.w + 0.06, 0.02, TANK.d + 0.06]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#141414" roughness={0.9} />
        </mesh>

        {/* rimless glass box */}
        <Pane size={[TANK.w, GLASS, TANK.d]} at={[0, 0.02 + GLASS / 2, 0]} thin={1} />
        <Pane size={[TANK.w, glassH, GLASS]} at={[0, GLASS + glassH / 2, TANK.d / 2 - GLASS / 2]} thin={2} />
        <Pane size={[TANK.w, glassH, GLASS]} at={[0, GLASS + glassH / 2, -TANK.d / 2 + GLASS / 2]} thin={2} />
        <Pane size={[GLASS, glassH, TANK.d - GLASS * 2]} at={[-TANK.w / 2 + GLASS / 2, GLASS + glassH / 2, 0]} thin={0} />
        <Pane size={[GLASS, glassH, TANK.d - GLASS * 2]} at={[TANK.w / 2 - GLASS / 2, GLASS + glassH / 2, 0]} thin={0} />
        {/* silicone seams in the corners */}
        {[
          [-1, -1],
          [-1, 1],
          [1, -1],
          [1, 1],
        ].map(([sx, sz]) => (
          <mesh key={`${sx}${sz}`} position={[sx * (IN_W / 2 - 0.012), GLASS + glassH / 2, sz * (IN_D / 2 - 0.012)]} raycast={noHit}>
            <boxGeometry args={[0.026, glassH, 0.026]} />
            <meshStandardMaterial color="#101010" roughness={0.4} />
          </mesh>
        ))}

        {/* background film on the back glass, for contrast behind the fish */}
        <mesh position={[0, GLASS + glassH / 2, -IN_D / 2 + 0.003]} raycast={noHit}>
          <planeGeometry args={[IN_W, glassH]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial map={tex.film} roughness={0.9} />
        </mesh>

        {/* gravel with caustics */}
        <mesh geometry={geo.ground} receiveShadow raycast={noHit}>
          <meshStandardMaterial
            ref={groundMat}
            map={tex.gravel}
            bumpMap={tex.gravel}
            bumpScale={1.5}
            roughness={0.95}
            emissive="#cfeeff"
            emissiveMap={tex.caustic}
            emissiveIntensity={0.22}
          />
        </mesh>

        {/* seiryu stones */}
        {STONES.map(([x, z, yaw, s, gi], i) => (
          <mesh key={i} geometry={geo.stones[gi]} position={[x, groundY(x, z) + s[1] * 0.2, z]} rotation={[0, yaw, 0]} scale={s} castShadow raycast={noHit}>
            <meshStandardMaterial map={tex.stone} bumpMap={tex.stone} bumpScale={1.2} roughness={0.85} />
          </mesh>
        ))}

        {/* driftwood */}
        {geo.wood.map((g, i) => (
          <mesh key={i} geometry={g} castShadow raycast={noHit}>
            <meshStandardMaterial map={tex.bark} bumpMap={tex.bark} bumpScale={2} roughness={0.9} />
          </mesh>
        ))}

        <mesh geometry={geo.plants} material={plantMat} raycast={noHit} />
        {!reduced && <Bubbles />}

        {/* one fish per skill */}
        {skills.map((s, i) => (
          <group
            key={s.name}
            ref={(g) => school.attach(i, g)}
            onPointerDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            onPointerOver={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              school.setHovered(i);
              onHover(i);
            }}
            onPointerOut={() => {
              if (school.hovered === i) school.setHovered(-1);
              onHover(null);
            }}
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              onSelect(school.active === i ? null : i);
            }}
          >
            <Fish sp={species[i]} bend={school.fish[i].bend} bump={tex.bump} rays={tex.rays} />
          </group>
        ))}

        <group ref={label}>
          {labelled !== null && (
            <Html center zIndexRange={[15, 10]} pointerEvents="none">
              <p className="tank-label">
                {skills[labelled].name}
                <span>{species[labelled].common}</span>
              </p>
            </Html>
          )}
        </group>

        {/* water: a faint tint through the volume and a bright surface line */}
        <mesh position={[0, (GLASS + WATER_TOP) / 2, 0]} renderOrder={2} raycast={noHit}>
          <boxGeometry args={[IN_W - 0.01, WATER_TOP - GLASS, IN_D - 0.01]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#9fd8d0" roughness={0.1} transparent opacity={0.1} depthWrite={false} />
        </mesh>
        <mesh position={[0, WATER_TOP, 0]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} renderOrder={3} raycast={noHit}>
          <planeGeometry args={[IN_W - 0.01, IN_D - 0.01]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#dff6f2" roughness={0.05} metalness={0.2} transparent opacity={0.35} side={THREE.DoubleSide} depthWrite={false} />
        </mesh>

        {/* LED light bar resting on the glass */}
        <group position={[0, TANK.h, 0]}>
          <mesh position={[0, 0.24, 0]} castShadow raycast={noHit}>
            <boxGeometry args={[TANK.w * 0.96, 0.05, 0.34]} />
            <meshStandardMaterial color="#b9bcbf" metalness={0.85} roughness={0.32} />
          </mesh>
          <mesh position={[0, 0.214, 0]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} raycast={noHit}>
            <planeGeometry args={[TANK.w * 0.9, 0.22]} />
            <meshStandardMaterial color="#ffffff" emissive="#f2f9ff" emissiveIntensity={night ? 2.4 : 1.4} />
          </mesh>
          {[-1, 1].map((s) => (
            <mesh key={s} position={[s * TANK.w * 0.47, 0.12, 0]} raycast={noHit}>
              <boxGeometry args={[0.04, 0.24, 0.3]} />
              <meshStandardMaterial color="#9a9da0" metalness={0.85} roughness={0.35} />
            </mesh>
          ))}
        </group>
      </group>
    </>
  );
}
```

```typescript

/*
 * The field guide: every skill at a glance, grouped by layer, beside the tank.
 * Rows and fish point at each other: hovering either tags the fish, picking a
 * row brings that fish to the front glass and lists the projects it swims through.
 */
function FieldGuide({
  active,
  hovered,
  hidden,
  onSelect,
  onHover,
  onOpenProject,
  onClose,
}: {
  active: number | null;
  hovered: number | null;
  hidden: boolean;
  onSelect: (i: number | null) => void;
  onHover: (i: number | null) => void;
  onOpenProject: (i: number) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <section className="desk-tank desk-glass" data-hidden={hidden ? "" : undefined} aria-labelledby="desk-tank-title" data-lenis-prevent>
      <div className="desk-tank__head">
        <p className="desk-tank__kicker">Field guide · {String(skills.length).padStart(2, "0")} species</p>
        <button type="button" className="desk-chip" onClick={onClose}>
          <ArrowLeft aria-hidden /> Desk
        </button>
      </div>
      <h2 id="desk-tank-title" className="desk-tank__title">The stack, alive</h2>
      <p className="desk-tank__lede">Each fish is a tool I build with. Pick one to see the projects it swims through.</p>

      {skillGroups.map((group) => (
        <div key={group} className="desk-tank__group">
          <h3 className="desk-tank__group-name">{group}</h3>
          <ul className="desk-tank__list">
            {skills.map((s, i) => {
              if (s.group !== group) return null;
              const sp = speciesOf(s.name);
              const open = active === i;
              const n = s.projects.length;
              return (
                <li key={s.name} data-open={open ? "" : undefined}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="desk-tank__row"
                    aria-expanded={open}
                    data-hover={hovered === i ? "" : undefined}
                    onClick={() => onSelect(open ? null : i)}
                    onPointerEnter={() => onHover(i)}
                    onPointerLeave={() => onHover(null)}
                    onFocus={() => onHover(i)}
                    onBlur={() => onHover(null)}
                  >
                    <span className="desk-tank__swatch" style={{ "--fish": sp.side, "--fin": sp.fin } as CSSProperties} aria-hidden />
                    <Image src={s.icon} alt="" width={22} height={22} className="desk-tank__icon" />
                    <span className="desk-tank__name">
                      {s.name}
                      <span className="desk-tank__species">{sp.common}</span>
                    </span>
                    <span className="desk-tank__uses" aria-label={`Used in ${n} of ${projects.length} projects`}>
                      {projects.map((_, k) => (
                        <span key={k} data-on={k < n ? "" : undefined} />
                      ))}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                  {open && (
                    <div className="desk-tank__detail">
                      {n === 0 ? (
                        <p>No project on the shelf uses it yet.</p>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <p>
                            Swims through {n} of {projects.length} projects:
                          </p>
                          <ul>
                            {s.projects.map((p) => (
                              <li key={p}>
                                <button type="button" className="desk-tank__project" onClick={() => onOpenProject(p)}>

                            ))}

                        </>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        </div>
      ))}
    </section>
  );
```

```css
/* ── Field guide: the skills panel beside the aquarium close-up ── */
.desk-tank {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 25;
  top: calc(var(--nav-h) + 0.75rem);
  bottom: 1.75rem;
  left: var(--page-pad);
  width: min(400px, 36vw);
  overflow-y: auto;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  padding: 1.15rem 1.15rem 1.4rem;
  border-radius: 1.1rem;
  color: var(--desk-cream);
  animation: tank-guide-in 520ms var(--ease-out) 380ms both;
  transition: opacity 200ms ease;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
}

.desk-tank[data-hidden] {
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

@keyframes tank-guide-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(-14px);
  }
}

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;

}

.desk-tank__list {

.desk-tank__list > li {

}

.desk-tank__row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto auto 1fr auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.7rem;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 3rem;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.5rem;

}

.desk-tank__row[data-hover],
.desk-tank__list > li[data-open] .desk-tank__row {

.desk-tank__row:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--signal);
  outline-offset: -2px;
}

/* a little fish silhouette in the species' own colors, so rows map to fish at a glance */
.desk-tank__swatch {
  position: relative;
  width: 22px;
  height: 12px;
  border-radius: 60% 40% 40% 60% / 50%;
  background: var(--fish);
  box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18);
}

.desk-tank__swatch::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 1px;
  right: -7px;

  border-width: 5px 0 5px 8px;
  border-color: transparent transparent transparent var(--fin);
  transform: scaleX(-1);
}

.desk-tank__icon {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  object-fit: contain;
}

.desk-tank__name {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;

}

.desk-tank__species {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.58rem;
  font-weight: 400;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  opacity: 0.6;
}

/* projects using the skill, out of the whole shelf */
.desk-tank__uses {
  display: flex;
  gap: 3px;
}

.desk-tank__uses > span {
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid rgb(255 240 220 / 0.45);
}

.desk-tank__uses > span[data-on] {
  background: var(--desk-cream);
  border-color: var(--desk-cream);
}

.desk-tank__detail {
  padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem 0.8rem 3.6rem;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: rgb(255 240 220 / 0.82);
  animation: tank-detail-in 240ms var(--ease-out) both;
}

@keyframes tank-detail-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-4px);
  }
}

.desk-tank__detail p {
  margin: 0 0 0.35rem;
}

.desk-tank__detail ul {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.desk-tank__project {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  min-height: 1.9rem;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.65rem;
  border: 1px solid rgb(255 240 220 / 0.3);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: transparent;
  color: inherit;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.58rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease;
}

.desk-tank__project svg {
  width: 11px;
  height: 11px;
}

@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .desk-tank__project:hover {
    background: var(--desk-cream);
    color: var(--ink);
  }
}

/* name tag that rides above a fish in the tank */
.tank-label {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.65rem;
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
  background: rgb(20 14 10 / 0.72);
  color: var(--desk-cream);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  white-space: nowrap;
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.tank-label span {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.52rem;
  font-weight: 400;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  opacity: 0.7;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .desk-tank,
  .desk-tank__detail {
    animation: none;
  }
}

/* phones: the guide becomes a bottom sheet under the tank */
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .desk-tank {
    top: auto;
    left: 0.75rem;
    right: 0.75rem;
    bottom: 0.75rem;
    width: auto;
    max-height: 50svh;
    padding: 1rem 0.9rem 1.2rem;
    animation-name: tank-sheet-in;
  }

  .desk-tank__title {
    margin-top: 0.6rem;
    font-size: 1.35rem;
  }

  .desk-tank__detail {
    padding-left: 0.5rem;
  }
}

@keyframes tank-sheet-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(16px);
  }
}
```

The tank now has its own L-shaped desk return on the left, with a head-on close-up view and a field-guide panel that lists every skill at once. I checked it with screenshots on desktop (1440×900) and phone (390×844); night mode and reduced motion are coded but I didn't screenshot them. Lint passes. `tsc` still shows the one type error at `DeskCanvas.tsx:100`, the same `onOpen` mismatch from before this work. Nothing is committed.

**L desk.** The desk now has a return joined to its left end, running out toward the room, in the same oak with drawer fronts. A plain wall stands behind it. The tank sits on the return with its front glass facing the room. It only shows in the new close-up, not in Top, Front or Angle.

**Camera.** Three ways in: the "Skills" chip on the desk card, a new "Skills" link in the top and mobile nav, or a `#skills` link in the address bar. Each one turns the camera left to look square at the tank.
- **Desktop:** the tank sits right of center, leaving the left side for the panel.
- **Phone:** the tank sits at the top and the panel becomes a bottom sheet.
- **Getting out:** "← Desk" returns to the previous view. Escape first deselects a fish, then exits. Scroll-zoom is turned off while you're at the tank.

**Skills panel.** All 10 skills show at once, grouped into Frontend, Backend and Data, so nobody has to chase moving fish:
- Each row has a small fish shape in that species' colors, the tool's icon, the skill name, the species name, and dots showing how many of the 5 projects use it.
- Hovering a row puts a name tag on its fish. Hovering a fish highlights its row.
- Clicking a row brings that fish to the front glass, enlarged, while the rest move to the back. The row opens to list the projects as buttons, and each button opens that project's book.

**More realistic tank.** Each skill is now a real freshwater species whose colors echo the tool's branding: React is a neon tetra, MySQL a blue discus, REST API an angelfish, and so on.
- **Fish:** properly shaped bodies that bend as they swim, scale texture and shimmer, see-through fins with visible rays, a forked, fan, veil, sword or lyre tail depending on the species, and eyes with a colored iris.
- **Tank:** rimless glass with green edges and black silicone seams, a dark film on the back glass, a light bar, gravel with drifting light patterns, grey stones, driftwood, swaying grasses and red-tipped bushes, and a bubble column. The tank glows brighter at night.

**Removed.** Selecting a fish no longer pulls its books off the shelf, because the shelf isn't visible from the tank view. The project buttons in the panel replace that.

**Caveats:**
- The neon tetra is small, true to the species, so even enlarged it can get lost behind bigger fish. I can make it larger, or make the other fish fade when one is selected.
- The fish are still built in code, not imported 3D models. They're much closer to the rest of the desk now, but not photoreal. Real models would need licensed glTF files.
- Your own `next dev` on port 3000 was already running. I took the screenshots against it and didn't start another server.

The new code is in [aquarium.tsx](src/components/hero/desk/aquarium.tsx), [species.ts](src/components/hero/desk/species.ts) and [skills.ts](src/lib/skills.ts). The tank and return sizes live in [constants.ts](src/components/hero/desk/constants.ts), and the camera framing is the `tank` view in [world.ts](src/components/hero/desk/world.ts).

```typescript
/*
 * The work record: one A4 sheet, read in front of the camera like the books.
 * Portrait at ~150 dpi so the type stays crisp when it fills the screen.
 */
function experiencePaperTexture(f: Fonts) {
  const W = 1240;
  const H = 1754;
  const m = 110;
  const { c, ctx } = surface(W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#f6f0e2";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  speckle(ctx, W, H, 5200, ["#fffaf0", "#cfc2a8"], 0.9);
  /* edges yellow a little, like paper that has lived in a folder */
  const edge = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, H * 0.35, W / 2, H / 2, H * 0.75);
  edge.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
  edge.addColorStop(1, "rgba(150,112,58,0.16)");
  ctx.fillStyle = edge;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillStyle = INK;
  ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
  ctx.font = `500 24px ${f.mono}`;
  ctx.fillText(`${site.name.toUpperCase()}  ·  WORK RECORD`, m, 130);
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.fillText(`Nº ${String(experience.length).padStart(2, "0")}`, W - m, 130);
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillRect(m, 156, W - m * 2, 3);

  ctx.font = `800 150px ${f.display}`;
  ctx.fillText("Experience", m - 6, 330);
  ctx.font = `italic 40px ${f.serif}`;
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.75;
  wrapLines(ctx, site.role, W - m * 2 - 260).forEach((line, i) => ctx.fillText(line, m, 400 + i * 50));
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  /* a rubber stamp, slightly crooked */
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(W - m - 120, 300);
  ctx.rotate(-0.16);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(232,93,44,0.82)";
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(232,93,44,0.82)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 6;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, 104, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, 90, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.font = `800 40px ${f.display}`;
  ctx.fillText("ON FILE", 0, 14);
  ctx.font = `500 16px ${f.mono}`;
  ctx.fillText("JD · PALOMA", 0, 50);
  ctx.restore();

  let y = 540;
  experience.forEach((item, i) => {
    ctx.fillStyle = INK;
    ctx.fillRect(m, y, W - m * 2, 2);
    ctx.font = `500 24px ${f.mono}`;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
    ctx.fillText(String(i + 1).padStart(2, "0"), m, y + 58);
    ctx.fillText(item.year.toUpperCase(), m + 100, y + 58);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.font = `800 66px ${f.display}`;
    ctx.fillText(item.title, m + 100, y + 140, W - m * 2 - 100);
    ctx.font = `italic 42px ${f.serif}`;
    ctx.fillText(item.place, m + 100, y + 196, W - m * 2 - 100);
    y += 250;
  });

  y += 40;
  ctx.font = `500 24px ${f.mono}`;
  ctx.fillText("EDUCATION", m, y);
  ctx.fillRect(m, y + 20, W - m * 2, 2);
  y += 82;
  education.forEach((item) => {
    ctx.font = `500 22px ${f.mono}`;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
    ctx.fillText(item.year.toUpperCase(), m, y);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.font = `700 34px ${f.display}`;
    ctx.fillText(item.title, m + 140, y, W - m * 2 - 140);
    ctx.font = `italic 28px ${f.serif}`;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.75;
    ctx.fillText(item.place, m + 140, y + 40, W - m * 2 - 140);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    y += 104;
  });

  ctx.fillRect(m, H - 150, W - m * 2, 2);
  ctx.font = `500 22px ${f.mono}`;
  ctx.fillText(`${site.email}  ·  ${site.phone}`, m, H - 104);
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.fillText("1 / 1", W - m, H - 104);
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  return toTexture(c);
}

/* manila folder cover with a typed label */
function folderCoverTexture(f: Fonts) {
  const W = 620;
  const H = 840;
  const { c, ctx } = surface(W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#d4b07a";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  speckle(ctx, W, H, 2600, ["#e6c894", "#a8854f", "#c49d62"], 1.1);
  /* a faint crease a little in from the spine */
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(90,62,26,0.12)";
  ctx.fillRect(34, 0, 3, H);

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(96, 110);
  ctx.rotate(-0.02);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#f7f1e3";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 430, 190);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(28,22,18,0.25)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.strokeRect(10, 10, 410, 170);
  ctx.fillStyle = INK;
  ctx.font = `500 18px ${f.mono}`;
  ctx.fillText("WORK RECORD · JD PALOMA", 30, 52);
  ctx.font = `800 64px ${f.display}`;
  ctx.fillText("Experience", 28, 130);
  ctx.font = `italic 26px ${f.serif}`;
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7;
  ctx.fillText(`${experience.length} roles · résumé inside`, 30, 166);
  ctx.restore();

  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(232,93,44,0.75)";
  ctx.font = `800 30px ${f.display}`;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(380, 720);
  ctx.rotate(-0.12);
  ctx.fillText("CONFIDENTIAL-ISH", 0, 0);
  ctx.restore();
  return toTexture(c);
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import { RoundedBox } from "@react-three/drei";
import { useFrame, useThree, type ThreeEvent } from "@react-three/fiber";
import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import * as THREE from "three";

/*
 * The work folder on the desk and the sheet inside it. The folder is a desk
 * body (draggable like everything else); the sheet flies to the camera on its
 * own, in world space, the way the project books do.
 */

/* A4 proportions, sized to sit inside the folder */
export const PAPER = { w: 1.4, h: 1.98 };
const FOLDER = { w: 1.55, d: 2.1 };
const OPEN_SECONDS = 1.6;
const FLAT = -Math.PI / 2;
/* the cover rests a touch open so the sheet inside shows */
const AJAR = 0.09;

const ease = (t: number) => (t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2);
const phase = (p: number, a: number, b: number) => ease(THREE.MathUtils.clamp((p - a) / (b - a), 0, 1));

/* Shared between the folder and the flying sheet: how far open, and where the sheet rests. */
export class PaperLink {
  p = 0;
  anchor: THREE.Object3D | null = null;

  setAnchor(o: THREE.Object3D | null) {
    this.anchor = o;
  }

  step(open: boolean, reduced: boolean, dt: number) {
    const goal = open ? 1 : 0;
    const step = reduced ? 1 : dt / OPEN_SECONDS;
    this.p = goal > this.p ? Math.min(goal, this.p + step) : Math.max(goal, this.p - step * 1.3);
  }
}

function Sheet({ map }: { map: THREE.Texture }) {
  return (
    <mesh castShadow receiveShadow>
      <boxGeometry args={[PAPER.w, PAPER.h, 0.008]} />
      {[0, 1, 2, 3, 5].map((k) => (
        <meshStandardMaterial key={k} attach={`material-${k}`} color="#f2ecdd" roughness={0.9} />
      ))}
      <meshStandardMaterial attach="material-4" map={map} roughness={0.88} />
    </mesh>
  );
}

type FolderProps = {
  cover: THREE.Texture;
  paper: THREE.Texture;
  link: PaperLink;
  onOpen: () => void;
};

export function ExperienceFolder({ cover, paper, link, onOpen }: FolderProps) {
  const flap = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const resting = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);

  useFrame(() => {
    const c = phase(link.p, 0, 0.3);
    if (flap.current) flap.current.rotation.z = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(AJAR, 2.75, c);
    /* the flying sheet takes over the moment it leaves */
    if (resting.current) resting.current.visible = link.p < 0.001;
  });

  /* a drag that ends on the folder is a move, not a request to read */
  const open = (e: ThreeEvent<MouseEvent>) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (e.delta > 6) return;
    onOpen();
  };

  return (
    <group onClick={open}>
      {/* back panel, with the tab along the far edge */}
      <RoundedBox args={[FOLDER.w, 0.02, FOLDER.d]} radius={0.01} smoothness={2} position={[0, 0.01, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow>
        <meshStandardMaterial color="#c9a46a" roughness={0.92} />
      </RoundedBox>
      <RoundedBox args={[0.6, 0.02, 0.22]} radius={0.01} smoothness={2} position={[-0.32, 0.01, -FOLDER.d / 2 - 0.09]} castShadow>
        <meshStandardMaterial color="#c9a46a" roughness={0.92} />
      </RoundedBox>

      {/* the sheet, pushed off-center so its edge and corner stick out of the folder */}
      <group ref={(g) => {
        resting.current = g;
        link.setAnchor(g);
      }} position={[0.16, 0.03, -0.02]} rotation={[FLAT, 0, -0.035]}>
        <Sheet map={paper} />
      </group>

      {/* front cover, hinged on the spine at -x */}
      <group ref={flap} position={[-FOLDER.w / 2, 0.045, 0]} rotation={[0, 0, AJAR]}>
        <group position={[FOLDER.w / 2, 0, 0]}>
          <RoundedBox args={[FOLDER.w, 0.016, FOLDER.d - 0.04]} radius={0.008} smoothness={2} castShadow receiveShadow>
            <meshStandardMaterial color="#d4b07a" roughness={0.92} />
          </RoundedBox>
          <mesh position={[0, 0.0085, 0]} rotation={[FLAT, 0, 0]}>
            <planeGeometry args={[FOLDER.w - 0.02, FOLDER.d - 0.06]} />
            <meshStandardMaterial map={cover} roughness={0.9} />
          </mesh>
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  );
}

type PaperProps = {
  map: THREE.Texture;
  open: boolean;
  reduced: boolean;
  night: boolean;
  link: PaperLink;
  onClose: () => void;
};

/* Mutable flight state, kept out of React like the shelf. */
class Flight {
  private rest = { pos: new THREE.Vector3(), q: new THREE.Quaternion(), s: new THREE.Vector3() };
  private present = new THREE.Vector3();
  private fwd = new THREE.Vector3();
  private tilt = new THREE.Quaternion();
  private q = new THREE.Quaternion();
  private readonly xAxis = new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0);

  step(
    link: PaperLink,
    camera: THREE.PerspectiveCamera,
    aspect: number,
    sheet: THREE.Group | null,
    dim: THREE.Mesh | null,
    face: THREE.MeshStandardMaterial | null,
    night: boolean,
  ) {
    const p = link.p;
    const a = link.anchor;
    const live = p > 0.001 && a !== null;
    if (sheet) sheet.visible = live;
    const s2 = phase(p, 0.38, 1);
    if (dim) {
      (dim.material as THREE.MeshBasicMaterial).opacity = s2 * 0.55;
      dim.visible = live && s2 > 0.01;
    }
    if (!live || !sheet || !a) return;

    a.updateWorldMatrix(true, false);
    a.matrixWorld.decompose(this.rest.pos, this.rest.q, this.rest.s);

    /* fill most of the height, or the width on tall screens */
    const tanHalf = Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(camera.fov / 2));
    const dist = Math.max(PAPER.h / (0.84 * 2 * tanHalf), PAPER.w / (0.9 * 2 * tanHalf * aspect));
    camera.getWorldDirection(this.fwd);
    this.present.copy(camera.position).addScaledVector(this.fwd, dist);

    /* lift out of the folder, tipping toward the viewer, then fly up to the eye */
    const s1 = phase(p, 0.18, 0.42);
    sheet.position.copy(this.rest.pos);
    sheet.position.y += 0.7 * s1;
    sheet.position.lerp(this.present, s2);
    sheet.position.y += Math.sin(Math.PI * s2) * 0.5;
    this.tilt.setFromAxisAngle(this.xAxis, 0.35 * s1 * (1 - s2));
    this.q.copy(this.rest.q).multiply(this.tilt).slerp(camera.quaternion, s2);
    sheet.quaternion.copy(this.q);

    /* the page reads by its own light once it's up, day or night */
    if (face) face.emissiveIntensity = (night ? 0.85 : 0.4) * s2;

    if (dim) {
      dim.position.copy(camera.position).addScaledVector(this.fwd, dist + 1.2);
      dim.quaternion.copy(camera.quaternion);
    }
  }
}

export function ExperiencePaper({ map, open, reduced, night, link, onClose }: PaperProps) {
  const camera = useThree((s) => s.camera) as THREE.PerspectiveCamera;
  const size = useThree((s) => s.size);
  const sheet = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const dim = useRef<THREE.Mesh>(null);
  const face = useRef<THREE.MeshStandardMaterial>(null);
  const [flight] = useState(() => new Flight());

  useFrame((_, delta) => {
    link.step(open, reduced, Math.min(delta, 1 / 30));
    flight.step(link, camera, size.width / size.height, sheet.current, dim.current, face.current, night);
  });

  return (
    <>
      <group ref={sheet} visible={false} onPointerDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <mesh>
          <boxGeometry args={[PAPER.w, PAPER.h, 0.008]} />
          {[0, 1, 2, 3, 5].map((k) => (
            <meshStandardMaterial key={k} attach={`material-${k}`} color="#f2ecdd" roughness={0.9} />
          ))}
          <meshStandardMaterial ref={face} attach="material-4" map={map} emissiveMap={map} emissive="#ffffff" emissiveIntensity={0} roughness={0.88} />
        </mesh>
      </group>

      {/* backdrop that dims the desk while the sheet is up; click it to put the sheet back */}
      <mesh
        ref={dim}
        visible={false}
        renderOrder={10}
        onClick={(e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          onClose();
        }}
        onPointerDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <planeGeometry args={[400, 400]} />
        <meshBasicMaterial color="#120a04" transparent opacity={0} depthWrite={false} />
      </mesh>
    </>
  );
}
```

Both changes work, and I checked them in screenshots at 1440×900, 1440×680 and 390×844. Types and lint pass.

**Skills list (aquarium panel)**
- The scrollbar is gone. Only the list scrolls now; the panel's title and "Desk" button stay put.
- The top edge fades once you've scrolled down. The bottom edge fades, with a small bouncing arrow, while more items are below.
- Each fade only shows when there's something to scroll to. On a tall desktop screen the whole list fits, so no fade appears.
- The fades also update when a row opens and the list gets longer.

**Experience folder**
- **On the desk:** it's now an upright manila folder with a tab and a printed "Experience" label on the cover. The cover sits slightly open and the paper sticks out past the top and right edges.
- **On click:** the cover swings open, the sheet lifts out and tilts, then flies up to face the camera, like the project books. The desk dims behind it.
- **The details are on the paper itself:**
  - name header with a small orange "ON FILE" rubber stamp
  - both roles with dates and companies
  - an Education section, which I added from your existing data
  - email and phone at the bottom
- **Controls:** a small bar under the paper holds Résumé ↗ and Close. Escape, Close or clicking the dimmed backdrop puts the sheet back. The full-page overlay and its CSS are removed.
- **Behavior:**
  - Dragging the folder doesn't open it; only a plain click does.
  - The sheet lights itself, so it stays readable at night.
  - Screen readers get the same record as text, because the paper is an image.

**Also fixed**
- The "Projects 05" tag no longer floats over the paper on phones; it hides while the paper or the tank is open.
- The old `DeskCanvas` type error is gone, because the folder's open handler changed.

New code is in [experience.tsx](src/components/hero/desk/experience.tsx), the paper and cover artwork in [textures.ts](src/components/hero/desk/textures.ts), and the panel in `FieldGuide` in [DeskHero.tsx](src/components/hero/DeskHero.tsx).

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-29 13:11:25Z)**_

Agreed. A canvas texture can't stay sharp. It gets resampled to fit the screen, and night lighting and screen size make it worse. The fix is to keep the paper as the animation but render the text as real HTML.

**Ideas**

1. **Paper becomes HTML (recommended).** The 3D sheet still flies up from the folder. When it lands, a real HTML page in the same paper style replaces it in place. Text is sharp at any size, selectable and readable by screen readers, it stays light in night mode, and it scrolls inside the paper with the same fades as the skills list. Closing reverses it: the HTML page fades out and the 3D sheet flies back into the folder.
2. **Folder tabs: Experience | Education.** The open paper gets index tabs along its top edge, like a real file folder. One subject per page means bigger type and less crowding. It works together with idea 1.
3. **Expandable roles.** Each role is one line (title, company, dates), and clicking opens 2–3 highlights plus the stack used. The stack chips link to the matching fish in the tank, the same way books link to fish. This needs new data: today each role has only a title, a company and a year, so the paper reads thin. I'd add `highlights` and `stack` fields to `experience`.
4. **Index cards.** Each role is a card that fans out of the folder, and clicking one flips it for details. It's very "desk", but the cards are small, so it suits 2–4 roles at most and is weaker on phones.
5. **Badges on the pegboard.** Each company is a lanyard ID badge hanging on the wall, and clicking one opens its detail card. It's fun and distinctive, but it splits the experience across the wall, and education doesn't fit the metaphor.
6. **Timeline along the cutting mat's ruler.** Years sit as marks on the ruler, with roles pinned at their dates. It's clever, but text on the 3D mat has the same readability problem as the paper. Skip it.

**Plan:** 1 + 2 + 3.
- The 3D sheet flies up and becomes an HTML paper sheet with tabs along the top.
- Body text is at least 16px, lines are capped around 60 characters, and the paper keeps its look: cream stock, mono labels, the serif italic for companies, and the stamp.
- Each role opens to show highlights and stack chips that jump to the fish.
- Phone: the sheet goes near full width with the controls stacked under it.

**Bug in your screenshot:** a second copy of the sheet is poking in at the bottom-right corner. I'll find and fix it as part of this work.

To build 3, I need the content: 2–3 highlight bullets per role and the tools you used at MoveForward and at Efunity. I can draft placeholders, but they'd be made up. Build 1 + 2 now, and add 3 once you send the highlights?

```typescript
"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

/*
 * For lists that scroll with their scrollbar hidden: reports which edges still
 * have more beyond them, so the `.scroll-fade` mask can fade only those edges.
 */
export function useScrollFade<T extends HTMLElement>() {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null);
  const [edges, setEdges] = useState({ top: false, bottom: false });

  const measure = useCallback(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const top = el.scrollTop > 2;
    const bottom = el.scrollTop + el.clientHeight < el.scrollHeight - 2;
    setEdges((e) => (e.top === top && e.bottom === bottom ? e : { top, bottom }));
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    measure();
    /* rows opening, closing, or swapping change the height without a scroll event */
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(measure);
    const watch = () => {
      ro.disconnect();
      ro.observe(el);
      Array.from(el.children).forEach((c) => ro.observe(c));
      measure();
    };
    watch();
    const mo = new MutationObserver(watch);
    mo.observe(el, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    return () => {
      ro.disconnect();
      mo.disconnect();
    };
  }, [measure]);

  return {
    ref,
    onScroll: measure,
    fade: {
      "data-fade-top": edges.top ? "" : undefined,
      "data-fade-bottom": edges.bottom ? "" : undefined,
    },
    more: edges.bottom,
  };
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import { ArrowUpRight, ChevronDown, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { education, experience, site } from "@/lib/content";
import { skills } from "@/lib/skills";
import { speciesOf } from "@/components/hero/desk/species";
import { useScrollFade } from "@/hooks/useScrollFade";

/*
 * The work record, as a real page. The 3D sheet flies up from the folder and
 * lands exactly where this sits, then hands over: same paper, but type that
 * stays sharp, selectable, and readable at any size or time of day.
 */

export type SheetRect = { top: number; left: number; width: number; height: number };

const TABS = [
  { id: "experience", label: "Experience", count: experience.length },
  { id: "education", label: "Education", count: education.length },
] as const;
type Tab = (typeof TABS)[number]["id"];

const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");

type Props = {
  /* where the 3D sheet landed, and where to read it (larger on phones) */
  landed: SheetRect;
  reading: SheetRect;
  closing: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onExited: () => void;
  onSkill: (index: number) => void;
};

export function WorkRecord({ landed, reading, closing, onClose, onExited, onSkill }: Props) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>("experience");
  const [openRole, setOpenRole] = useState<number | null>(0);
  const [settled, setSettled] = useState(false);
  const tabs = useRef<(HTMLButtonElement | null)[]>([]);
  const body = useScrollFade<HTMLDivElement>();

  /* start on the landed sheet, then unfold to the reading size */
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = requestAnimationFrame(() => setSettled(true));
    tabs.current[0]?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(id);
  }, []);

  const onTabKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    if (e.key !== "ArrowRight" && e.key !== "ArrowLeft") return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const next = tab === "experience" ? 1 : 0;
    setTab(TABS[next].id);
    tabs.current[next]?.focus();
  };

  const rect = settled && !closing ? reading : landed;
  const title = TABS.find((t) => t.id === tab)!.label;

  return (
    <div
      className="desk-sheet"
      data-closing={closing ? "" : undefined}
      style={rect as CSSProperties}
      role="dialog"
      aria-labelledby="desk-sheet-title"
      onAnimationEnd={(e) => {
        if (closing && e.target === e.currentTarget) onExited();
      }}
    >
      <div className="desk-sheet__head">
        <p className="desk-sheet__kicker">{site.name} · Work record</p>
        <button type="button" className="desk-sheet__close" aria-label="Put the record back" onClick={onClose}>
          <X aria-hidden />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* folder tabs: one subject per page keeps the type large */}
      <div className="desk-sheet__tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Record sections">
        {TABS.map((t, i) => (
          <button
            key={t.id}
            ref={(el) => {
              tabs.current[i] = el;
            }}
            type="button"
            role="tab"
            id={`desk-sheet-tab-${t.id}`}
            aria-controls="desk-sheet-panel"
            aria-selected={tab === t.id}
            tabIndex={tab === t.id ? 0 : -1}
            onClick={() => setTab(t.id)}
            onKeyDown={onTabKey}
          >
            {t.label} <span>{pad(t.count)}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="desk-sheet__title-row">
        <h2 id="desk-sheet-title">{title}</h2>
        <span className="desk-sheet__stamp" aria-hidden>
          On file
        </span>
      </div>

      <div
        ref={body.ref}
        onScroll={body.onScroll}
        {...body.fade}
        id="desk-sheet-panel"
        className="desk-sheet__body scroll-fade"
        role="tabpanel"
        aria-labelledby={`desk-sheet-tab-${tab}`}
        tabIndex={0}
        data-lenis-prevent
      >
        {tab === "experience" ? (
          <ol className="desk-sheet__roles">
            {experience.map((role, i) => {
              const open = openRole === i;
              return (
                <li key={`${role.title}-${role.year}`} data-open={open ? "" : undefined}>
                  <button type="button" className="desk-sheet__role" aria-expanded={open} aria-controls={`desk-sheet-role-${i}`} onClick={() => setOpenRole(open ? null : i)}>
                    <span className="desk-sheet__index">{pad(i + 1)}</span>
                    <span className="desk-sheet__role-main">
                      <span className="desk-sheet__dates">{role.year}</span>
                      <span className="desk-sheet__role-title">{role.title}</span>
                      <span className="desk-sheet__place">{role.place}</span>
                    </span>
                    <ChevronDown className="desk-sheet__chev" aria-hidden />
                  </button>
                  {open && (
                    <div id={`desk-sheet-role-${i}`} className="desk-sheet__detail">
                      <ul className="desk-sheet__highlights">
                        {role.highlights.map((h) => (
                          <li key={h}>{h}</li>
                        ))}
                      </ul>
                      <p className="desk-sheet__label">Stack</p>
                      <ul className="desk-sheet__stack">
                        {role.stack.map((name) => {
                          const k = skills.findIndex((s) => s.name === name);
                          const sp = speciesOf(name);
                          const fish = <span className="desk-tank__swatch" style={{ "--fish": sp.side, "--fin": sp.fin } as CSSProperties} aria-hidden />;
                          return (
                            <li key={name}>
                              {k >= 0 ? (
                                <button type="button" className="desk-sheet__chip" onClick={() => onSkill(k)} title={`See ${name} in the aquarium`}>
                                  {fish}
                                  {name}
                                </button>
                              ) : (
                                <span className="desk-sheet__chip">{name}</span>
                              )}
                            </li>
                          );
                        })}
                      </ul>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ol>
        ) : (
          <ol className="desk-sheet__schools">
            {education.map((item) => (
              <li key={`${item.title}-${item.place}`}>
                <span className="desk-sheet__dates">{item.year}</span>
                <span className="desk-sheet__school-title">{item.title}</span>
                <span className="desk-sheet__place">{item.place}</span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ol>
        )}
      </div>
      {body.more && <ChevronDown className="desk-sheet__more" aria-hidden />}

      <div className="desk-sheet__foot">
        <a href={`mailto:${site.email}`}>{site.email}</a>
        <a className="desk-sheet__resume" href={site.resume} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
          Résumé <ArrowUpRight aria-hidden />
        </a>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

```
